bc2abe56.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security.
* Experience driving the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building the technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors).

**About The Job**
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
  
  
As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your business acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and present solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.
  
  
You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving engagement within existing ones. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend business expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted business motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through demos, pilots and workshops.
* Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. c597f2ad.title: GCP Data Architect
c597f2ad.description:
The Data Architect will be responsible for designing end-to-end cloud-native data architectures on GCP, aligned to business strategy and scalability requirements. They will lead large-scale data modernization programs, including migration from on-premise or traditional platforms (such as Teradata, Oracle, Hadoop, or legacy data warehouses) to GCP services like BigQuery, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub.

The role requires close collaboration with Google account managers to leverage platform capabilities, credits, and joint go-to-market opportunities. The architect will engage regularly with senior client and internal stakeholders to translate complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes and investment decisions.

They will define data governance frameworks, data modelling standards, and best practices for cloud data platforms, and will guide and mentor engineering teams through implementation. The candidate will also be expected to contribute to pre-sales and solutioning discussions, including effort estimation and architecture proposals.

**Key Skills & Knowledge Required**

**Cloud & Platform Expertise** The candidate must have deep, hands-on expertise with GCP data services including BigQuery, Cloud Dataflow, Cloud Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer (Airflow), Cloud Storage, and Looker. Experience with GCP networking, IAM, and security controls relevant to data platforms is essential.

**Data Modernization** Proven track record of leading at least one large-scale modernization program migrating from traditional platforms such as Teradata, Oracle Exadata, Hadoop/HDFS, or on-premise data warehouses to GCP. Experience in data migration strategy, schema conversion, ETL/ELT re-platforming, and cutover planning is critical.

**Data Architecture & Modelling** Strong command of data warehouse design (Kimball, Inmon, Data Vault), data lake and lakehouse architectures, and modern data mesh principles. Ability to design for performance, cost efficiency, and long-term scalability.

**Data Engineering** Working knowledge of data pipeline design using tools such as Apache Beam, Spark, dbt, or Dataflow. Familiarity with streaming and batch processing patterns.

**Stakeholder & Client Engagement** Demonstrated ability to engage with C-suite and senior stakeholders translating architectural decisions into business value, managing expectations, and presenting confidently in governance forums and executive reviews.

**Google Ecosystem Collaboration** Prior experience working alongside Google account managers, solution engineers, or in a Google partner ecosystem is highly desirable. Ability to leverage Google's resources, best practices, and support structures as part of delivery.

**Governance & Compliance** Knowledge of data governance frameworks, metadata management, data lineage, and compliance requirements (GDPR, HIPAA, or relevant regional standards).

**Soft Skills** Strong communication and storytelling ability, executive presence, comfort with ambiguity in complex programs, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams across geographies.

**Qualifications**

A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Google Professional Data Engineer or Cloud Architect certification is strongly preferred. 15+ years of overall experience in data roles, with at least 4–5 years in cloud data architecture on GCP.

**Nice to Have**

Experience with multi-cloud architectures (GCP + AWS or Azure), familiarity with AI/ML pipelines on Vertex AI, and exposure to FinOps practices for cloud cost optimization.

**Role Summary**

This role combines people leadership with technical oversight and hands-on implementation, providing guidance, coaching, and support to engineering teams while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. The manager partners closely with stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of technology solutions, supports technical decision-making, and helps teams navigate complex and evolving business challenges. **Responsibilities**

* Support workforce planning, resource allocation, hiring, onboarding, and succession planning activities.
* Ensure adherence to security, risk management, compliance, and technology governance standards.
* Encourage adoption of modern engineering practices, automation, cloud technologies, and AI-driven solutions where appropriate.
* Build strong partnerships across technical and non-technical stakeholder groups and effectively communicate team priorities, progress, and outcomes.
* Participate in strategic initiatives and other leadership responsibilities as assigned.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in IT project management, software development, or IT service delivery. Previous leadership experience required.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. PMP, ITIL, or Agile certifications preferred.
* Proven experience leading and developing engineering teams in a technology-driven environment.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, cloud-native application development, and technology delivery.
* Working knowledge of AWS cloud technologies, AI/LLM-powered solutions, APIs, and modern application architectures.
* Hands-on proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, GitHub, deployment pipelines, and Agile development practices.
* Experience supporting technical decision-making, solution delivery, and engineering execution across multiple initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and develop engineers while fostering a positive and inclusive team culture.
* Experience operating in ambiguous environments and helping teams navigate change, uncertainty, and evolving priorities.
* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and organizational skills.
* Commitment to continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Technical leader with a strong engineering foundation and a passion for developing people.
* Comfortable guiding teams through complex technical and business challenges and contributing directly to implementation when needed.
* Demonstrates intellectual curiosity, learning agility, and a growth mindset.
* Encourages innovation and experimentation while maintaining focus on business outcomes.
* Thrives in fast-paced environments and brings a proactive, ownership-driven approach to leadership.
* Builds trust, develops talent, and creates an environment where teams can perform at their best.

**Location**

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.

**Our mission**

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

**Our commitment to you**

Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success-at work and in life-with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:

**Financial wellness**  We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.

**Physical wellness** We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.

**Personal wellness**  We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.

**How we work**

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

85cf72dc.title: Azure Data Architect
85cf72dc.description:
**We are seeking a highly experienced and visionary Azure Databricks Architect with 12 to 14 years of total IT experience to lead the strategy, design, and implementation of enterprise-grade cloud data platforms. In this role, you will be responsible for defining modern Lakehouse architectures using Azure Databricks, architecting scalable data integration pipelines, driving data governance, and guiding organizations through complex data modernization and cloud transformation journeys.**

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Architectural Design & Strategy**

* Lakehouse Blueprinting: Design and deploy enterprise-scale Delta Lakehouse solutions leveraging the Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold layer design pattern) on Azure Databricks.
* Cloud Data Integration: Define end-to-end data ingestion, processing, and orchestration frameworks integrating Azure Databricks with Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Event Hubs/Kafka, Azure Synapse Analytics, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2).
* Legacy Modernization: Lead technical strategy for migrating legacy on-premises or cloud environments (e.g., Hadoop, Teradata, Netezza, SQL Server) to native Azure Databricks platform architectures.
* GenAI & Analytics Enablement: Architect data environments that support Machine Learning workflows, MLOps, MLflow, and Generative AI applications integrated with Databricks Vector Search and Feature Store.

**Governance, Security & Compliance**

  
  

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* **Total Experience: 12 to 14 years in IT and Data Engineering/Architecture.**
* **Architect Experience: Minimum 45 years in a lead Cloud Data Architect role, with dedicated, hands-on focus on Azure Databricks and Delta Lake ecosystems.**
* **Core Technical Stack:**

+ **Databricks Ecosystem: Databricks Lakehouse Platform, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Structured Streaming, Databricks SQL, MLflow, Auto Loader.**
+ **Azure Cloud Services: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Event Hubs, Azure Key Vault, Azure Functions, Azure Cosmos DB.**
+ **Languages: Python (PySpark), SQL, Scala.**
+ **DevOps & IaC: Terraform, Azure DevOps, Git, ARM templates, Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs).**
+ **Data Modeling: Dimensional Modeling (Star/Snowflake), Data Vault 2.0, Relational vs. NoSQL schema design patterns.**

* **Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field.**

**Preferred Certifications**

* **Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional or Databricks Certified Solution Architect**
* **Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)**
* **Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)**

52c8c152.description:
.

Proventeq is looking for a challenge-driven Technical Architect to strengthen our SaaS product development and technical delivery capabilities. * Excellent knowledge of C#/.NET, SQL Server and web technologies such as React.
* Proven expertise in SaaS product development for Azure. Marketplace, including integration with the SaaS Fulfillment APIs (v2), landing page and webhook handling, and subscription lifecycle management; experience with the marketplace metering service is a plus.

* Experience designing cloud-native Azure architectures (for example App Service, Container Apps or AKS, Service Bus, Azure SQL, Key Vault) and Infrastructure as Code (Bicep or Terraform).
* Good understanding of AI/ML technologies, ideally including building solutions with Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI), Azure AI Search and Azure AI Document Intelligence.

* Strong understanding of modern development methodologies and tools, including Agile, Azure DevOps (or GitHub) and automated testing.
* Awareness of secure development, data protection and compliance requirements (GDPR; SOC 2 / ISO 27001 environments).
* Strong technical leadership: able to propose, design and defend technical solutions.
* Expertise in producing high-quality technical documentation: technical specifications, architecture decision records and proposals.
* Entrepreneurial mindset and excellent client-facing skills
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience) [to confirm with client]

**Desirable skills and knowledge**

* Good knowledge of SharePoint and/or the Enterprise Content Management (ECM) domain.
* Experience with SharePoint Premium (formerly Microsoft Syntex), Microsoft Purview or SharePoint Embedded.
* Experience with migration from ECM or collaboration platforms such as OpenText, Documentum, FileNet, Box, Google Workspace or Lotus Notes.
* Experience building AI agents or Copilot extensions.
* Microsoft certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Developer or Azure AI Engineer, and familiarity with the Microsoft ISV programmes (ISV Success, co-sell).
* Familiarity with the Microsoft Commercial Marketplace SaaS Accelerator reference implementation.

**Personal attributes**

* Can-do attitude and comfort with ambiguity in a growing product environment.
* Clear communicator with both technical teams and senior client stakeholders.
* Collaborative approach to working across time zones.
* Curiosity about emerging technology and willingness to teach others.

**What we offer**

* Competitive salary + discretionary performance bonus
* Flexible working, open culture, and opportunities for fast career progression.
* Private health insurance
* Rest up with 25 days holiday per year

78227f82.title: Domain Architect
78227f82.description:
Domain Architect

**Reports to:** Lead Domain Architect, Manager Flex Arch, Head of Architecture  
   
**Division:** Architecture & Strategy   
  
**Location:** Bangalore / Gurugram 

**Purpose**

The Domain Architect defines the end-to-end technical architecture to support the delivery of the investment slate, guiding and influencing business delivery, and ensuring alignment to target-state technology. This role requires strong domain engagement across Wealth / HNW and Financial Services, with exposure to Capital Markets, Trading & Settlement, Market Rates, Managed/Investment Funds, and Financial Advisor platforms.

**Capabilities, Experience & Qualification Requirements**

* **Essential Capabilities (Core):** Decision Quality, Strategic Mindset, Situational Adaptability, Self-awareness, Courage, Accountability.
* **Technical Capabilities:**

+ Strong business acumen and engagement skills to influence business strategy, shape and prioritise outcomes, and develop domain roadmaps.
+ Ability to lead and maintain backlog of business outcomes and portfolio view of the domain.
+ Experience in scaled agile structures coordinating with solution architects.
+ Proven business engagement and influencing skills with fact-based analysis.
+ Understanding trade-offs in technology change while delivering business benefit.
+ Commercial acumen, negotiation, and business alignment.
+ Experience with cloud technologies and general software architecture across OLTP, warehouse, workflow, and mobile applications.
+ Exposure to trading, settlement, market rates, and capital markets projects requiring responsiveness, throughput, and reliability.

* **Experience:**

+ 10+ years in Technology industry.
+ 5+ years in Architecture, with agile practices in large organisations under regulatory/legacy constraints.

* **Qualification Requirements:**

+ Degree in Computer Science / Information Systems or equivalent.
+ Architecture or technology-related certifications (cloud preferred).
+ Business acumen in capital markets, wealth, financial advisor strategy, managed/investment funds, and general banking/financial services is an advantage.

**Key Decisions**

* Deliver quality attribute-based architecture (technical debt, failure analysis, service performance, scalability, availability).
* Define target-state architectures and roadmaps.
* Manage technical debt and recommend interventions to reduce/decommission legacy platforms.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Lead technical direction-setting for stories/epics/features.
* Deliver end-to-end technical outcomes across domains.
* Identify service impacts and sequence initiative features on service backlogs.
* Provide technical direction and leadership across the lifecycle.
* Create and maintain Target State Architecture and map components to asset management.
* Align application roadmap to NAB technology strategy and architectural principles.
* Perform optimisation, scaled modelling, walkthroughs, and design reviews.
* Drive backlog grooming, raise features/epics/stories, and provide architecture input for prioritisation.
* Identify external dependencies.
* Conduct impact analysis of functional/non-functional requirements, regulatory impacts, and risks.
* Document architectural decisions for compliance.
* Validate design artefacts for completeness and testability.
* Assist engineers with issue diagnosis and root cause analysis.
* Support production releases under You build it, you run it.

**Key Stakeholder Groups**

* Business domain executives, Product Owners
* Technology delivery teams/executives
* Release Train Engineers
* Architecture & Strategy & Advisory

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Engagement and influence in domain-centric roadmaps.
* Influence in legacy platform decommissioning/tech debt reduction.
* Clear definition and simplification/automation of capability build in target state.
* Operate as trusted advisor to business and technology executives.

afac32f0.title: Technical Customer Solutions Manager, India CSM Team
afac32f0.description:
**Description**
Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
  
  
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.
  
  
You will take end-to-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.
  
  
Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best-practices are applied, including: (1) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.
  
  
In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.
  
  
#aws-ags-india
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
* Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Math, or a related field
* Experience in customer-facing roles
* Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AWS or other cloud certification
* Knowledge of the software development/engineering lifecycle from conception to delivery or IT lifecycle
* Experience coordinating between project teams and customers to meet unique customer requirements

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS India - Delhi
  
  
Job ID: A10579550

7df0a9b8.title: Sr. Cloud Applications Consultant
7df0a9b8.description:
**Opentext - The Information Company**
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  
**AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.**
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
**Your Impact**
Reporting to the TSS (Technical Success Services) Practice Manager, the Sr. Cloud Applications Consultant is part of the technical managed services team, responsible for end-to-end technical delivery, including administration and management of the OpenText Documentum product suite for global customers.
  
  
We are seeking a technically resourceful professional with the ability to deliver exceptional customer experience in a challenging and rewarding environment.
  
  
You will join a growing team providing world-class operational support, including hands-on troubleshooting and administration for enterprise customers, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure service level commitments and customer satisfaction are consistently achieved.
  
  
**What The Role Offers**

* Relevant experience: 5–8 years
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field (required).
* Strong hands-on experience in administering and managing the OpenText Documentum platform
* Leveraging AI and automation to accelerate troubleshooting, improve operational efficiency, and drive innovative solutions for complex Documentum support challenges
* Experience with core Documentum components: D2, Content Server, xPlore, CTS, D2-REST, DFS, DFC, BOF, DQL, and Documentum Administrator

**What You Need To Succeed**

* Representing OpenText professionally in all interactions with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders
* Demonstrating strong customer focus, empathy, and clear written and verbal communication
* Responding to and solving customer technical requests, showing an understanding of the customer's managed hosted environment and applications within the OpenText Cloud, enabling resolution of complex technical issues.
* Operating, administering, and maintaining production Documentum applications in accordance with defined policies and procedures
* Monitoring applications, infrastructure, and services; troubleshooting alerts to ensure service level agreement (SLA) compliance
* Managing incidents, problems, changes, and releases within an ITIL-aligned service delivery model
* Collaborating with Product Support, Cloud Operations, Network, and cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical issues
* Maintaining accurate operational documentation, status reporting, and stakeholder communication
* Providing knowledge sharing, guidance, and mentoring to team members and customers as required
* Escalating risks, issues, and deviations in a timely manner and supporting continuous operational improvement

**Preferred Skills**

* Documentum Life Sciences modules – Q&M and R&D
* InfoArchive and/or Core for Capital Projects
* Experience managing Documentum in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containerized deployments
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm
* Experience supporting incident, problem, change, and release management within an ITIL-based service delivery model
* Understanding of object-oriented programming, web services, LDAP, and RDBMS concepts
* Working knowledge of Unix and Windows operating systems
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and collaboration skills in fast-paced, globally distributed environments
* Preferred certifications:
* Documentum certification
* ITIL (Foundation or higher)
* Any Cloud certification (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

**One Last Thing**
OpenText is more than just a corporation, it's a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned. Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and collaboration. At OpenText, we don't just have a culture; we have character. Choose us because you want to be part of a company that embraces innovation and empowers its employees to make a difference.
  
  
OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Cloud Administration, Cloud Infrastructure, IAM, Compute Management, Network Administration, Storage Management, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Cloud Security, Monitoring, Incident Management, Backup & Disaster Recovery, Cost Optimization, Patching, Governance.

Job Overview

Vynedam Group of Industries is looking for an experienced and detail-oriented **GeM Bid Manager** to manage the complete tender lifecycle, ensuring that all bids are accurate, compliant, commercially viable, and submitted within deadlines.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) portal, government tendering procedures, procurement documentation, and bid management. Experience in government tenders and GeM operations will be highly preferred.

* Review tender documents and prepare bid/no-bid recommendations.
* Develop and maintain compliance matrices, document trackers, and bid submission calendars.
* Coordinate with HR, Finance, Legal, Technical, OEM, Procurement, and Supply Chain teams.
* Ensure all tender documents are accurate, complete, approved, and submitted within specified deadlines.
* Maintain document versions and ensure only approved final documents are uploaded.
* Coordinate pre-bid activities, tender clarifications, and post-submission responses.
* Maintain complete bid records, audit trails, and management approval documentation.
* Coordinate reverse-auction activities within management-approved commercial limits.
* Identify tender risks, compliance gaps, and submission-related issues, escalating them to management when necessary.
* Lead the post-award handover process from Bid Management to the delivery team.

Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong knowledge of the GeM portal and government tender lifecycle.
* Experience with government procurement procedures and tender documentation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to identify risks and compliance gaps.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and document management.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination skills.
* High attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tender deadlines simultaneously.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Procurement, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3–7 years of relevant experience in bid management, tender management, or government procurement.
* Hands-on GeM portal and government tender experience is highly preferred.
* Ability to independently manage tender documentation, compliance requirements, and bid submissions.

Compensation and Work Arrangement

* **Annual CTC:** ₹7.2 LPA – ₹10.8 LPA.

* **Client Visits:** Candidates must be willing to visit the client's office for meetings whenever required.
* **Notice Period:** 15–30 days; candidates currently serving their notice period are preferred.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a proactive professional who can independently manage multiple tenders, coordinate with internal stakeholders, maintain strict documentation controls, and ensure timely and compliant bid submissions.

Candidates with hands-on experience in GeM bidding, government procurement, compliance management, and reverse auctions will be preferred.

How to Apply

Interested candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply with their updated resume.

Pay: ₹720,000.00 - ₹1,080,000.00 per year

* Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to clarify outcomes, success measures, priorities, scope boundaries and acceptance expectations.
* Build and maintain integrated delivery plans, release forecasts and milestones; communicate confidence, assumptions, options and trade-offs in business language, including the impact of delivery choices on cost, capacity, scope, risk and timelines.
* Manage Scrum events including Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Review and Retrospective; ensure each sprint has a clear goal, realistic commitment and actionable improvement outcomes.
* Coach teams in Scrum and Lean practices as appropriate, while protecting team self-organisation and avoiding command-and-control task allocation.
* Ensure backlogs and work items meet the agreed Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, and that Jira data provides reliable traceability and delivery insight.
* Actively manage RAID, cross-team dependencies, decisions, blockers, resource constraints and third-party commitments; escalate early with clear impact and recovery options.
* Orchestrate delivery across squads, platforms and workstreams by managing decision flow, cross-squad dependencies, sequencing constraints and delivery assurance activities.
* Use evidence and metrics such as predictability, throughput, cycle time, ageing work, escaped defects, release outcomes and team improvement trends to guide decisions.
* Track delivery against intended benefits, measurable value, business outcomes and agreed success criteria, ensuring progress is visible beyond activity completion.
* Coordinate release readiness across testing, architecture, security, risk, change, service management and application support, including operational handover, runbooks, monitoring, support contacts and known issues.
* Maintain transparent stakeholder communication through concise status reporting, governance updates, demonstrations and decision forums, ensuring no surprises; own delivery input into senior governance forums, steering updates, escalation discussions and leadership reporting where required.
* Promote quality, resilience, security, regulatory compliance and control adherence throughout the delivery lifecycle, including ownership of change-control readiness, audit evidence and regulatory delivery obligations where applicable.
* Facilitate/participate in Scrum of Scrums or equivalent dependency forums where required and contribute to delivery standards, templates, communities of practice and continuous improvement, with focus on portfolio/workstream alignment, delivery risk visibility and consistent delivery assurance practices.
* Create an inclusive, psychologically safe and accountable team environment where constructive challenge, learning and feedback are encouraged.
* Mentor less experienced Scrum Masters and delivery colleagues and share reusable practices across the delivery community.

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

007ce8d9.description:

We are the Windows Servicing and Delivery (WSD) organization, dedicated to keeping over 1.8 billion Windows devices secure and productive by delivering timely updates and innovations to all versions of Windows. Our work helps to protect users and their mission critical infrastructure in a fast-changing security landscape. We create and support new business opportunities across Microsoft, especially with the large and growing Windows installation base. We build delightful experiences for our customers and build products and solutions to empower our commercial and enterprise customers to keep their devices secure, compliant and up to date with latest innovations in Windows.

We are looking for a **Principal Technical Program Manager** to lead a team of TPMs and Product Managers across Windows Server and Networking, two foundational areas that power enterprise workloads and experiences across the Windows ecosystem. You will work closely with engineering, product, security, servicing, and customer-facing teams to identify the highest-impact customer problems, translate them into clear priorities, and drive programs from strategy through execution and customer impact.

This role requires a leader who is equally comfortable going deep into complex technical problems and stepping back to understand the broader product, customer, and business context. You will help your team navigate ambiguity, make the right technical and product tradeoffs, use data and customer signals to drive decisions, and influence teams across organizational boundaries. You will lead and grow a high-performing team of PMs, creating clarity and accountability while developing their technical depth, product judgment, and leadership capabilities. You will attract, develop, and retain outstanding talent and build an inclusive environment where people can do their best work.

As an AI-First leader, you will incorporate and coach your team on the responsible and effective use of AI across product management and engineering execution. You will also help identify opportunities where AI can fundamentally improve how we understand customer problems, diagnose and manage Windows systems, and deliver secure and reliable experiences at scale.

We value passion, creativity, drive, agility, accountability, technical curiosity, and a desire to continuously learn. Our customers are at the heart of everything we do, and delivering exceptional Windows experiences is our top priority. If you're excited about leading and developing a solid PM organization, shaping critical Windows Server and Networking investments, solving difficult technical and customer problems, and creating impact at Windows scale, we would love to hear from you.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

3dc25409.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience leading technical program management initiatives and delivering infrastructure solutions.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of dedicated experience in a technical program manager role.
* Deep domain expertise in backend infrastructure, distributed systems, evaluation systems, or testing frameworks.
* Experience or strong interest in leveraging modern AI/ML capabilities, Large Language Models (LLMs), and agentic workflows to modernize Technical Program Manager (TPM) functions (e.g., automated dependency tracking, predictive risk modeling, and operational streamlining).
* Proven track record of driving cross-functional alignment, managing distributed teams across multiple time zones, and prioritizing complex workstreams amidst ambiguity.

**About The Job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
  
  
The Search Serving Infrastructure (SSI) team is at the heart of Google Search. Our mission is to provide a reliable, highly efficient, and performant serving framework that powers the Search ecosystem handling billions of queries a day. We address massive-scale engineering challenges, from reducing latency and CPU/TPU capacity footprints to driving large-scale architectural simplification efforts (like deprecating legacy monolithic servers in favor of modern, scalable services).
  
  
In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Scope, shape, and lead large-scale programs spanning multiple engineering tracks. Co-develop strategies, goals, and success metrics for the broader organization.
* Perform technical assessments to evaluate engineering scope, establish milestones, define timeframes, and assess resourcing needs. Demonstrate technical judgment equivalent to a practicing Software Engineer in the infrastructure domain.
* Identify, anticipate, and manage risks, deliverables, and interdependencies across different Search Platforms and partner teams. Build mechanisms to optimize governance and information flow.
* Drive continuous optimizations in operational cadence, tooling, and communication, minimizing process friction while fostering development velocity and quality.
* Advocate alignment across disparate teams with differing objectives. Guide and influence cross-functional peers, driving consensus for technical directions and prioritizing features against constraints.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. 7117f35e.title: Senior Program Manager - Employee Relations
7117f35e.description:
**Role Summary for Senior Program Manager - Employee Relations (Individual contributor role)**

The incumbent will serve as a pivotal individual contributor responsible for driving high-impact Employee Relations and HR governance outcomes across R1 locations. The role will require end-to-end ownership of employee matters, grievances, disciplinary processes, performance-related interventions and sensitive workplace concerns while ensuring that all actions are handled with objectivity, consistency, confidentiality, and strong documentation discipline. In addition to managing day-to-day ER service delivery, the incumbent must bring strong knowledge of HR compliances, statutory requirements, labor codes, employment regulations, and policy governance to proactively identify risks, strengthen compliance controls, and support legally sound decision-making. The role is also expected to drive strategic HR and ER initiatives that improve workplace experience, reduce organizational risk, and enable consistent people practices across sites.

  

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* **Grievance and Inquiry Resolution:** Proactively manage and resolve employee grievances and inquiries, ensuring that all issues are addressed promptly and effectively. This involves working closely with employees and management to facilitate open communication and resolution.
* **Collaboration on Performance Improvement:** Work in tandem with business leaders to address performance improvement issues. This involves collecting relevant information, participating in the review of performance improvement documents, and offering strategic recommendations to enhance employee performance.
* **HR Compliance, Labor Code Governance & Risk Mitigation:** Own and support HR-related statutory compliances, labor code readiness, employment law requirements, and internal governance obligations to ensure adherence with applicable legal and organizational standards. Proactively identify compliance gaps, assess people-risk exposure, recommend mitigation plans, partner with Legal/Compliance teams where required, and ensure timely reporting for internal governance and audit readiness.
* **Strategic Initiative Design and Execution:** Lead the design, planning, and execution of structured ER and HR initiatives, including labor code implementation, policy revisions, grievance framework improvements, workplace risk controls, associate engagement interventions, and process standardization. Translate insights from cases, compliance reviews, and business needs into scalable initiatives that strengthen governance and improve employee experience.
* **ER Service Delivery Management:** Oversee the delivery of ER services across R1 locations, utilizing platforms like Service Now for query management, tiering support, and other communication channels. This includes ensuring timely and effective responses to employee inquiries and concerns.
* **ER Case Management and Advisory:** Independently manage and advise on complex ER cases, including disciplinary matters, grievances, involuntary exits, leaves of absence, performance-related concerns, workplace conduct issues, and other sensitive or high-risk matters. Ensure each case is assessed through a fair, consistent, legally informed, and well-documented approach, with appropriate stakeholder alignment and timely closure.
* **Consistency and Documentation:** Guarantee consistency in the approach and resolution of employee concerns. This includes meticulous preparation of documentation and reports to ensure high-quality records are maintained.
* **Monthly Reporting:** Conduct monthly reporting of ER cases via the internal tracking log for the site. This involves compiling data, analyzing trends, and presenting findings to relevant stakeholders.
* **Data Insights and Trend Analysis:** Share data insights at the site level, derived from trends observed through various focus groups, listening posts, industry trends and ER case logs. Use this data to inform strategic decisions and enhance employee engagement.
* **Liaison with Stakeholders:** Act as a liaison with Business Leaders, HR Business Partners, Legal Compliance and other ER Advisors to keep them aligned and informed of the progress of employee relations matters on-site. This ensures alignment and continuity in HR practices across the organization.
* **Policy Review, Governance and Implementation:** Play an active role in reviewing, strengthening, implementing, and communicating ER/HR policies, procedures, and programs. 959d2917.title: Technical Presales

**Company:**
Preta Systems

**Location:**
Vadodara, Gujarat / Hybrid

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
5 - 10 years

**Industry:**
Enterprise SaaS | Digital Experience Infrastructure | Runtime Technology

About Preta Systems

www.pretasystems.com

Preta is building the
**control layer for digital experiences**
— a SaaS platform that enables businesses to configure, deploy, manage, and govern interactive UI experiences across live digital products without repeatedly modifying application code.

We're entering our go-to-market phase and looking for a technically strong, customer-facing professional who can bridge the gap between our product, engineering team, and enterprise customers.

We're hiring a
**Technical Presales Lead**
who can take ownership of technical product demonstrations, customer discussions, solution presentations, and technical evaluations.

**4. Sales & Engineering Collaboration**

* Partner with business development to progress qualified opportunities toward commercial conversion.
* Create technical presentations, demo environments, architecture diagrams, and integration documentation.
* Communicate customer feedback and technical requirements to the product team.
* Contribute to technical proposals, solution documentation, and enterprise evaluations.

Required Skills & Experience

* 5 - 10 years of experience in technical presales, solutions engineering, solution architecture, or customer-facing software engineering.
* Strong understanding of
  **JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, DOM, browser architecture, and modern web applications**
  .
* Familiarity with REST APIs, SDK integrations, cloud infrastructure, and SaaS platforms.
* Understanding of enterprise security concepts, authentication, performance, and application integration.
* Experience delivering technical product demonstrations and presentations.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving, presentation, and customer engagement skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment.

Good to Have

* Experience with B2B SaaS, developer tools, MarTech, AdTech, or digital experience platforms.
* Knowledge of browser SDKs, JavaScript injection, Shadow DOM, and single-page applications.
* Experience with enterprise PoCs, technical RFPs, and security questionnaires.
* Understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS or Cloudflare.
* Previous experience working with international enterprise customers.

What Makes This Role Interesting?

* Work directly with the founder on taking a new SaaS infrastructure product to market.
* Play a key role in shaping Preta's technical sales and customer adoption strategy.
* Engage with product leaders, CTOs, and engineering teams across industries.
* Influence product development through direct customer interaction.
* Opportunity to grow into a leadership role as the company scales internationally.

Who Should Apply?

We're looking for someone who is
**technically hands-on, commercially aware, and an excellent communicator**
.

You should be equally comfortable explaining browser architecture to a CTO, conducting a live product demonstration, and working with developers to resolve an integration challenge.

At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
**Job Description**
F5 gives the world’s largest businesses, service providers, governments, and consumer brands the ability to securely deliver every app, anywhere—with confidence. We do this by working collaboratively in an innovative environment, helping each other succeed. We take great pride in being trusted advisers to our customers, offering the best solutions for their interests. If our mission and culture excite you, we would love to talk to you!
  
  
**The SE Job Overview:**
The Solutions Engineer (SE) is a sales and technical role with focus on customer/partners and is part of the sales organization. The SE’s primary responsibility is to support the sales team with technical skills and provide technical knowledge around F5 solutions to our customers. To be effective, an SE needs to have excellent technical skills and knowledge on both F5 products and the “eco-system” that we work in. Fear not, we do provide training and certification to keep abreast with these critical skills!
  
  
The high-level objective is to achieve the allocated sales target and selling relevant F5 solutions and products to our customers business needs, in partnership with the Sales Account Manager. From our customer(s) perspective, the SE is a trusted adviser who proactively learns and understands their technical and business challenges and is able to propose effective solutions to mitigate their concerns/offer gainful solutions. The F5 SE not only presents the technical features but also business benefits in the Technical Value Proposition.
  
  
Sounds interesting? Read on!
  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* Articulate the F5 product strategy, messaging and positioning F5’s value proposition and solutions for customer business objectives
* Provide technical expertise through sales presentations, solution designs, solution demonstrations, proof of concepts by various mediums – in-person/virtual presentations, white boards etc
* Determine viability of opportunity and map out organizational structure.
* Drive the sales process in partnership with the Account Manager, by identifying the Technical Decision Maker, getting their technical validation, support, and sponsorship.
* Consistently provide world-class customer service through the customer life cycle
* Work collaboratively with internal technical and sales resources, share best practices, updates, offer and seek expertise as the need arises in various opportunities.

**How you’ll do it:**

* Experience in secure Cloud architectures, Security product like WAF, ZTNA, Firewall, SSL VPN
* Experience with public/private cloud vendors and automation toolsets, basic CI/CD understanding.

* Experience with container orchestration solutions (eg: OpenShift, Kubernetes)

* 10+ years of related industry experience with FSI & Enterprise background
* 6+ years of experience in a similar customer facing technical role
* Familiarity/experience with F5 or similar industry solution deployment a plus
* Relevant certifications a plus

8feffafc.description:
### **Summary**

Role Type: Hybrid Working, #LI-Hybrid
  
Primary Location: Hyderabad, India
  
Other Location: Mumbai, India
  
Relocation Support: Yes
  
  
What if your technical expertise could help clinical teams identify risks earlier and protect the quality of clinical trial data? As Expert Solution Architect, Clinical Data Analytics & Technology (RBQM Data Analyst), you will implement and support Risk-Based Quality Management and Central Monitoring solutions across Clinical Data Operations. Working with clinical, data, central monitoring, and technology teams, you will configure monitoring platforms, develop risk indicators and analytics, and deliver scalable solutions that strengthen study oversight and data-driven decision-making.

### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Configure and maintain Central Monitoring studies, dashboards, reports, and analytics solutions for given studies
* Develop Key Risk Indicators, Quality Tolerance Limits, risk signals, and statistical outputs/DQA aligned with approved monitoring strategies/ Specifications.
* Draft Central monitoring platform specification and refer clinical protocol, CRF, Study ALS and vendor data transfer specification.
* Extract, transform, and integrate clinical and operational data used for centralised monitoring and risk analytics.
* Test, validate, and quality-check study configurations, dashboards, indicators, and statistical monitoring outputs.
* Support study go-live activities, ongoing maintenance, change requests, troubleshooting, and monitoring updates.
* Develop automation scripts and analytical solutions using R, Python, Structured Query Language, or comparable technologies.
* Maintain technical documentation and contribute reusable templates, code libraries, training, and continuous-improvement initiatives.
  

  

**Essential Requirements**

* Seven to ten years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical research, or healthcare technology industry.

* Hands-on experience with Risk-Based Quality Management, Central Monitoring, clinical data analytics, reporting, or clinical technology implementation.

* Experience configuring and maintaining Central Monitoring platforms, such as CluePoints or an equivalent solution.

* Experience implementing Key Risk Indicators, Quality Tolerance Limits, risk signals, and statistical monitoring test/ DQA approaches for clinical studies.

* Working knowledge of analytical programming using R, Python, Structured Query Language, Statistical Analysis System, or comparable technologies.

* Proficiency with business intelligence and data-visualisation tools such as Power BI, Spotfire, or Tableau.

* Familiarity with electronic data-capture systems, clinical data repositories, metadata-driven environments, and Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium standards.

* Understanding of Risk-Based Quality Management, centralised monitoring, Good Clinical Practice, Good Practice quality requirements, and applicable data-privacy regulations.

* Interpret protocols, monitoring plans, quality plans, critical data, endpoints, CtQ factors, risks, and study-specific needs

* Understanding ingestion, harmonization, mapping, transformation and data from different sources like EDC, CTMS, IRT/IWRS, laboratory and other third-party data

* Use SAS, SQL, R, Python or equivalent languages for data manipulation, analytics, automation, and troubleshooting

* Manage setup, go-live, refreshes, change requests, protocol amendments, troubleshooting, and study closeout/archival activities

* Deliver assigned work on time and to first time-right quality standards.
  

  

**Desirable Requirements**

* Experience developing automated data pipelines, reusable code libraries, and scalable analytical solutions.
* Experience supporting advanced analytics clinical trial activities.
* Knowledge of Study Data Tabulation Model and Analysis Data Model standards.
* Experience supporting quality-control documentation, validation, audit readiness, and regulated system implementation.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

O2C Solution Lead

We are seeking a skilled Order-to-Cash (O2C) Solution architect to play a key role in configuring, implementing, and supporting O2C processes within the Central Finance (CFIN) system. The O2C Solution architect will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, process owners, and technical teams to ensure seamless integration of O2C functions within the CFIN framework. This role requires deep functional knowledge of O2C processes, as well as the ability to translate business requirements into system configurations that optimize efficiency, accuracy, and business performance. This position requires close coordination with Deployment team, Functional architects and external vendors, to maintain and evolve the O2C architecture, ensuring it meets business needs and complies with ABB's standards.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Finance Services business Finance Process Data Systems division in Bangalore, India.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* O2C Process Configuration: Configure and maintain Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes such as credit management, billing, collections, and accounts receivable within the Central Finance (CFIN) system, ensuring alignment with business needs and industry best practices. Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders and process owners to thoroughly understand their requirements, document functional specifications, and translate these into system configurations.
* System Integration: Facilitate seamless integration of O2C processes within the CFIN system, as well as with other enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, etc.), ensuring smooth data flow and automation of processes across platforms. User Support & Training: Provide ongoing functional support to end-users, addressing issues, offering solutions, and conducting training to ensure optimal utilization of the system and full understanding of O2C processes.
* Testing & Validation: Participate in testing and validation activities for new configurations, enhancements, and fixes, ensuring they meet business and functional requirements. Process Optimization: Regularly monitor and evaluate O2C processes to identify opportunities for automation, efficiency improvements, and best practice implementation within the CFIN system.
* Documentation & Compliance: Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for O2C system configurations, process flows, and integration points, ensuring compliance with internal standards and regulatory guidelines. Collaboration with Technical Teams: Work closely with IS architects, developers, and technical teams to ensure that functional requirements are correctly implemented and aligned with system design specifications.
* Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution: Provide expert troubleshooting support for O2C-related system issues, working collaboratively with cross-functional teams to resolve any challenges promptly. Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about the latest industry trends, best practices, and system updates to continuously enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of O2C processes within CFIN.
* Project and New Demand Management: Take ownership of configuring new demands or changes in system functionality, ensuring proper alignment with system design documentation and business requirements. O2C-Related Data Management: Oversee the management and accuracy of O2C-related data within the system, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and compliance with business rules across all O2C processes.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. Relevant certifications in O2C SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP CFIN, or IT architecture. Proven experience (5+ years) in O2C process management, with a strong background in system configuration and implementation within SAP or similar ERP environments (SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP CFIN).
* Strong functional knowledge of Order-to-Cash processes, including order management, credit management, billing, collections, and accounts receivable. Experience in configuring O2C processes in SAP or similar ERP systems, with a solid understanding of integration points and data flows across systems. Familiarity with Central Finance (CFIN) and integration with other finance-related modules.
* Experience with requirements gathering, business analysis, and documentation of functional specifications. High level understanding on Credit Management & Integration process between source & CFIN High level Down Payment concepts, Industry solution for Project Cash flow, Provisioning based on global rule sets, Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and technical teams. A strong focus on continuous improvement and automation, with a passion for driving innovation within enterprise systems. Experience in managing relationships with external vendors and third-party service providers to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions. Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic work environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

* Ensure adherence to security standards, data privacy requirements, and regulatory compliance.

**YOUR TALENT:**
**Key Requirements:**

* 8+ years of experience in solution or system architecture within complex IT environments
* Experience in DTC, eCommerce, retail, or omnichannel environments
* Strong understanding of integration architectures and modern engineering practices
* Experience working in global matrix organizations
* Strong communicator bridging business and engineering teams
* Structured, pragmatic, decision-oriented, and governance-aware working style

Strong understanding of:
  
  

* Microservices and distributed systems
* Digital channels (web, app, commerce capabilities)
* Retail and store systems (POS, omnichannel integrations)

* Security concepts (OAuth2, SSO, CIAM).

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Job Title: SAP C4C Trainer (SAP Sales and Service Cloud)

**Location:** Tamil Nadu, India (Chennai / Coimbatore / Madurai, as applicable)  
**Job Type:** Full-time / Part-time  
**Experience:** 3–7 years of relevant SAP C4C experience  
**Work Mode:** Remote (based on requirement)

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and knowledgeable SAP C4C (Cloud for Customer) Trainer to deliver professional training to students, working professionals, and aspiring SAP consultants. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in SAP C4C, a good understanding of customer relationship management (CRM), sales, and service processes, and the ability to explain system functionalities through practical examples and real-time business scenarios.

The candidate should be capable of delivering structured training sessions, conducting hands-on demonstrations, and guiding learners through SAP C4C configuration, business processes, and industry-relevant projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Deliver comprehensive training on SAP C4C concepts, functionalities, and business processes.
* Explain SAP C4C architecture and its role in customer relationship management.
* Train learners on account management, contact management, and customer data management.
* Provide training on lead management, opportunity management, and sales activities.
* Explain sales forecasting, sales territories, and pipeline management, where applicable.
* Train learners on service requests, service tickets, case management, and customer support processes.
* Cover activity management, task management, and customer interactions.
* Explain SAP C4C configuration, business roles, access control, and organizational structures.
* Provide training on workflow rules, reports, dashboards, and analytics.
* Explain integration between SAP C4C and SAP ERP / SAP S/4HANA.
* Introduce learners to data migration, data integration, and system configuration concepts.
* Prepare training materials, presentations, practical exercises, and assessments.
* Guide learners through real-time scenarios, case studies, and project-based exercises.
* Evaluate learner performance and provide technical guidance.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Strong hands-on experience in SAP C4C / SAP Cloud for Customer.
* Good understanding of CRM, sales, and customer service business processes.
* Knowledge of account management, lead management, and opportunity management.
* Experience with SAP C4C sales or service functionalities.
* Understanding of system configuration, business roles, and access management.
* Familiarity with workflows, reporting, dashboards, and data management.
* Knowledge of integration with SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and teaching skills.
* Ability to explain functional concepts clearly to beginners and experienced professionals.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience as an SAP C4C Consultant, SAP CRM Consultant, or SAP C4C Trainer.
* Experience in SAP C4C implementation, configuration, rollout, or support projects.
* Knowledge of SAP Sales Cloud and SAP Service Cloud solutions.
* Experience with data migration, integration, and business process configuration.
* Previous experience delivering classroom, corporate, or online training.
* Relevant SAP certifications are an added advantage.

Candidate Profile

We welcome applications from experienced SAP C4C Consultants and CRM professionals who are passionate about teaching and mentoring learners. Candidates should have practical project experience and the ability to connect SAP functionalities with real-world sales and customer service processes through demonstrations, case studies, and hands-on exercises.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹49,000.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

41956cb3.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
41956cb3.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Technical Program Manager
  
  
**Overview**
Foundational Data & Model Services sits in Data & AI Foundations, inside Business & Market Insights. We own the data that B&MI's analytics and insights products are built on: the pipelines that bring it in, the data models that shape it, and the standards that keep it consistent for everyone downstream. When a product team needs transaction data modelled a particular way, or a new source onboarded, or a definition that means the same thing in two products, that is us.
  
  
About half the estate is Hadoop and Hive with on-prem ETL that has been running for years and still serves live products. The other half is Databricks, and we are moving the rest across. The work is two things at once: keeping the old platform reliable while it is still load-bearing, and rebuilding the data models properly on the new one rather than lifting and shifting what is already there.
  
  
The team itself is new, brought together from teams that used to sit apart, and the roadmap is still being written. Plenty is undecided. If that reads as an opportunity rather than a risk, you will enjoy this.
  
  
Role
  
  
You Will Own The Delivery Plan Across The Squads Doing This Work, And Manage The Dependencies Between Them, The Platform Teams We Rely On, And The Product Teams Waiting On Us. Specifically, You Will
  
  
Own delivery of the shared data models and pipelines that several product teams depend on, where success is adoption rather than features shipped.
  
  
Run the migration off Hadoop and on-prem ETL onto Databricks: sequencing, cutover, and actually switching the old thing off.
  
  
Keep the legacy platform's operational commitments visible in the plan, so migration work does not quietly starve the systems still in production.
  
  
Broker the dependencies we do not control, working with central platform, cloud operations and data governance teams.
  
  
Run vendor and partner engagement: roadmap alignment, milestone tracking, performance against commitments.
  
  
Bring enough technical depth to challenge decisions on data modelling, pipeline design and data quality, and to explain the trade-offs to business stakeholders without flattening them.
  
  
Set how a new team plans and reports: intake, prioritization, cadence, and what leadership sees each month.
  
  
**All About You**
We do not expect any one person to bring all of this, so apply if most of it fits.
  
  
Experience running technical programs in data engineering, data platforms or analytics infrastructure.
  
  
Working knowledge of the stack on both sides of the migration: Hadoop, Hive and traditional ETL on one side, Databricks, Spark and orchestration tooling such as Airflow on the other. Strong SQL throughout. Enough to scope work and spot risk without an engineer translating every conversation.
  
  
Experience of platform migrations where the old system stays live throughout and the decommissioning is the hard part.
  
  
Understanding of data modelling and why it matters: schemas, lineage, common definitions, and what breaks downstream when they drift.
  
  
Understanding of data governance, access control and handling customer data in a regulated business.
  
  
A track record of getting internal teams to adopt shared platforms, which comes down to persuasion, evidence and follow-through rather than mandate.
  
  
Comfortable with ambiguity: able to build a credible plan before every input is settled, and to change it without treating that as a failure.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
