c686670e.title: Software Architect
c686670e.description:
At Verint, we believe customer engagement is the core of every global brand. Our mission is to help organizations elevate Customer Experience (CX) and increase workforce productivity by delivering CX Automation. We hire innovators with passion, creativity, and drive to answer constantly shifting market challenges and deliver impactful results for our customers. Our commitment to attracting and retaining a talented, diverse, and engaged team creates a collaborative environment that openly celebrates all cultures and affords personal and professional growth opportunities. Learn more at www.verint.com .

**Overview of Job Function:**

As a Software Architect for the WFM/PM platform in India, you will define the technical blueprint for how Verint's engineering team builds, scales, and evolves its Java-based product suite. You will own system-level design decisions, establish cross-cutting architectural standards, and ensure the platform is secure, observable, performant, and maintainable at enterprise scale. You will apply proven software craftsmanship principles — including 12-Factor App methodology, SOLID principles, and design patterns — to guide the team toward a high-quality, long-lived codebase. You will work at the intersection of hands-on technical depth and strategic engineering leadership.

  

**Principal Duties and Essential Responsibilities:**

**1. Architecture and System Design**

* Define and own the technical architecture for WFM, PM, and Platform product areas - spanning Java backend services, frontend systems, APIs, database design, and cloud/on-premises infrastructure.
* Create, maintain, and communicate Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and system design documentation.
* Lead system-level design reviews; enforce architectural governance and review gates for new features and initiatives.
* Apply and enforce 12-Factor App methodology, SOLID principles, and established design patterns across the codebase.
* Design enterprise-grade RESTful API contracts, versioning policies, backward compatibility strategies, and service boundary definitions.
* Architect solutions for both Cloud (AWS/Azure) and On-Premises deployment environments, ensuring consistency and portability.

**2. Java Backend Engineering Excellence**

* Own architectural implementation of Java and Spring Boot microservices, including Spring MVC, JPA/Hibernate, and integration patterns.
* Define and govern database architecture across PostgreSQL, MS SQL, and other relational stores; own schema design, query optimization, stored procedure standards, and indexing strategy.
* Establish standards for unit and integration testing using PowerMock, Mockito, and JUnit; define test coverage thresholds and enforcement mechanisms.
* Evaluate and govern usage of build tools including Gradle, Maven, and npm; define dependency management and versioning standards.
* Champion secure-by-design practices aligned with OWASP Top 10 and enterprise customer security requirements.

**3. Frontend and Full-Stack Oversight**

* Define frontend architecture standards for ReactJS-based applications, including component design, state management, and performance optimization.
* Govern integration patterns between backend Java services and frontend applications, including API design, authentication (OAuth 2.0/JWT), and error handling.
* Provide architectural guidance on NodeJS services where applicable, including integration with Java backend systems.
* Ensure accessibility, internationalisation (i18n), and cross-browser compatibility are considered in frontend architecture decisions.

**4. DevOps, CI/CD, and Operational Excellence**

* Define CI/CD pipeline architecture using Jenkins and other DevOps tooling; establish standards for automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
* Own deployment architecture for application server environments including Tomcat, JBoss, and Oracle WebLogic Server (14+).
* Establish observability architecture: logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting standards for both cloud and on-premises deployments.
* Define SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets; lead post-incident architecture reviews and drive systemic reliability improvements.

**5. Technical Standards, Governance, and Mentorship**

* Define and own engineering standards: coding guidelines, testing strategy, performance benchmarks, scripting conventions (Python, Shell, Batch), and security requirements.
* Establish and maintain the technology radar; govern adoption of third-party libraries, frameworks, and tools.
* Own the technical debt roadmap; prioritize and sequence refactoring and modernization initiatives.
* Serve as the architectural mentor for Senior and Lead engineers; enable the team to make sound design decisions independently.
* Facilitate architecture guilds, design sprints, and tech talks to elevate team-wide architectural thinking.

**6. Cross-Functional and Global Collaboration**

* Partner with global R&D leadership, Product, and Engineering leaders in UK and the US to align architecture with product strategy.
* Provide architectural input into roadmap planning, make-vs-buy evaluations, and platform investment decisions.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders including Product, Customer Success, and executive audiences.
* Engage directly with customers and enterprise stakeholders on production issues requiring architectural-level analysis and resolution.

  

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

* 12+ years of professional software engineering with 3+ years in a dedicated architecture, principal engineer, or technical lead role.
* B.E. / B.Tech. / M.Tech. / M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related STEM field.
* Equivalent exceptional practical experience with a demonstrable architectural portfolio will be considered.
* Demonstrable record of architecting large-scale, multi-tenant enterprise Java applications serving enterprise customers.
* Experience driving architecture across distributed, cross-timezone engineering organizations.

  **Technical Skills:**
* Back-End: Expert-level Java and Spring Boot (Spring MVC, JPA/Hibernate, Spring Security). Deep expertise in RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Frontend: Strong architectural knowledge of ReactJS. Familiarity with Angular and NodeJS.
* Databases: Expert-level PostgreSQL and MS SQL relational database architecture. Deep SQL query optimization, stored procedure design, schema migration, and indexing strategy.
* Application Servers: Oracle WebLogic Server (14+), Tomcat, and JBoss/WildFly.
* Build and Tooling: Gradle, Maven, npm. IDE expertise with IntelliJ IDEA and Eclipse.
* Testing: Expert-level JUnit, Mockito, PowerMock, and integration testing strategy.
* Scripting: Python, Shell Script, and Batch Script for automation and operational tooling.
* Cloud and Infrastructure: AWS or Azure architecture. Docker and Kubernetes. IaC fundamentals (Terraform or CloudFormation).
* CI/CD: Jenkins pipeline architecture and CI/CD platform design.

  **Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications:**
* Experience in WFM, PM, or enterprise analytics SaaS domains.
* Familiarity with Verint WFO, PM product architecture.
* AWS Solutions Architect Professional or Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification.
* Experience with TOGAF, C4 model, or equivalent architectural frameworks.
* Contributions to open-source projects or published technical content.
* Knowledge of regulatory compliance architecture (GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001).

7d668c4f.title: Enterprise Agentic Automation Developer/Solutions Architect
7d668c4f.description:
**Date posted** 10/14/2026

### **Category** **Information Technology****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **18884****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/14/2026**

**We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

**You Are**

You have spent years building enterprise systems that actually solve business problems, not just demonstrate technical capability. You understand that the real challenge is not deploying an AI model, it is designing the solution architecture that makes it trustworthy, scalable, and maintainable across Finance, HR, Sales Operations, and Legal teams who need it to work every single day. You think in systems, not features. When someone describes a manual process, you are already mapping the integration points, data flows, governance requirements, and failure modes before they finish talking.

You are equally comfortable whiteboarding an agentic AI architecture with a VP of Finance and writing Python code to integrate Azure OpenAI with SAP. You have built enough automation solutions to know when a workflow needs intelligent document processing versus a simple API call, and you can explain that tradeoff clearly. You do not wait for perfect requirements. You ask the right questions, prototype quickly, and iterate with stakeholders who may not speak your technical language but absolutely know their business pain.

At Synopsys, you will architect AI and automation solutions that reduce manual work for 30,000 employees across critical business functions, and the platform you build will matter.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Design and build enterprise AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search, and Copilot Studio that automate Finance, Sales Operations, HR, Order Management, and Legal processes
* Architect and develop agentic AI systems and intelligent automation workflows on UiPath, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Functions that integrate with SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, SuccessFactors, and Workday
* Lead end-to-end solution delivery from requirements gathering and architecture design through development, testing, deployment, and production support
* Build reusable frameworks, integration patterns, and engineering standards for AI agent development that other developers can adopt across the enterprise automation portfolio
* Partner directly with business stakeholders in Finance, GTM, HR, and Operations to identify automation opportunities, assess feasibility, prioritize initiatives, and translate requirements into technical solutions
* Establish and enforce governance, security, Responsible AI practices, and DevOps standards using Azure DevOps or GitHub for CI/CD and source control
* Mentor developers on AI solution design, Azure architecture, integration patterns, and automation best practices

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Reduce manual effort across Finance, Sales Operations, HR, and Order Management by deploying AI-powered automation that handles document processing, data extraction, workflow orchestration, and decision support at scale
* Accelerate Synopsys' enterprise AI strategy by establishing reusable frameworks and patterns that enable faster, more consistent delivery of intelligent automation solutions across business functions
* Improve operational accuracy and compliance by building governed, auditable AI systems with proper security controls, error handling, and monitoring
* Enable business growth without proportional headcount increases by creating scalable automation platforms that handle increasing transaction volumes and process complexity
* Strengthen cross-functional collaboration by translating technical capabilities into business value that Finance, HR, and Operations leaders can understand and trust
* Build institutional knowledge and capability by mentoring developers and establishing engineering standards that raise the quality and maintainability of the entire automation portfolio
Drive measurable ROI through solutions that demonstrably* time, reduce errors, and improve process efficiency in production environments

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 8-12+ years building enterprise applications, automation solutions, or integration platforms, with at least 3 years working directly with AI or Generative AI technologies in production environments
* Deep hands-on experience with Azure AI Services including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, and Azure AI Search, plus Azure Integration Services like Logic Apps, Functions, Service Bus, and API Management
* Proven ability to design and deploy intelligent automation using platforms like UiPath, Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio, and Dataverse
* Strong development skills in Python, C#, and JavaScript, with solid understanding of REST APIs, SOAP, webhooks, SQL, and data modeling
* Direct experience integrating enterprise applications such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, SuccessFactors, or Workday in complex business environments
* Working knowledge of AI governance, Responsible AI practices, cloud security, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and source control using Azure DevOps or GitHub, experience with JIRA for project management is a plus

**Who You Are**

* You can sit in a room with a Finance Director who describes a month-end close process and walk out with a solution architecture that addresses the real bottleneck, not just the symptom they mentioned
* You write code that other developers can actually maintain, you document your integration patterns, you build error handling that helps operations teams diagnose issues without calling you at midnight
* You push back when a stakeholder asks for an AI agent but the problem actually needs a well-designed workflow, and you can explain why in terms they understand and respect
* You have shipped enough production systems to know that governance, security, and supportability are not afterthoughts, they are design constraints you bake in from the start
* You mentor junior developers by showing them how you think through a problem, not just handing them the answer, and you genuinely care about raising the technical capability of the team
* You stay current with AI and automation technology not because it is trendy but because you know the difference between a useful new capability and vendor hype, and you can evaluate both critically

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will join the Enterprise Agentic Process Automation team, which drives business transformation through AI, intelligent automation, process optimization, and enterprise integration. The team delivers capabilities across Finance, Sales Operations, Order Management, HR, Business Operations, and other functions, with emphasis on operational efficiency, scalability, governance, and innovation. Current initiatives include AI agents, document intelligence, finance automation, process orchestration, and enterprise platform integrations. The team operates in Bengaluru and collaborates closely with business stakeholders and IT teams across Synopsys globally.

**Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  
  

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

What we offer

**About M&G India**

We are M&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.

Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M&G is transforming as a business.

**About M&G**

Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.

Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.

Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.

• To work collaboratively with colleagues and take personal accountability to maintain and enhance controls you are responsible for to support improvement of the overall control environment, customers outcomes and a reduction in M&G plc's operational risk. • Own end-to-end delivery across assigned squad(s) or workstreams, from demand and initiation through planning, execution, release and closure, with clear accountability for delivery confidence, delivery health and outcome achievement. • Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to clarify outcomes, success measures, priorities, scope boundaries and acceptance expectations. • Build and maintain integrated delivery plans, release forecasts and milestones; communicate confidence, assumptions, options and trade-offs in business language, including the impact of delivery choices on cost, capacity, scope, risk and timelines. • Manage Scrum events including Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Review and Retrospective; ensure each sprint has a clear goal, realistic commitment and actionable improvement outcomes. • Coach teams in Scrum and Lean practices as appropriate, while protecting team self-organisation and avoiding command-and-control task allocation. • Ensure backlogs and work items meet the agreed Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, and that Jira data provides reliable traceability and delivery insight. • Actively manage RAID, cross-team dependencies, decisions, blockers, resource constraints and third-party commitments; escalate early with clear impact and recovery options. • Orchestrate delivery across squads, platforms and workstreams by managing decision flow, cross-squad dependencies, sequencing constraints and delivery assurance activities. • Use evidence and metrics such as predictability, throughput, cycle time, ageing work, escaped defects, release outcomes and team improvement trends to guide decisions. • Track delivery against intended benefits, measurable value, business outcomes and agreed success criteria, ensuring progress is visible beyond activity completion. • Coordinate release readiness across testing, architecture, security, risk, change, service management and application support, including operational handover, runbooks, monitoring, support contacts and known issues. • Maintain transparent stakeholder communication through concise status reporting, governance updates, demonstrations and decision forums, ensuring no surprises; own delivery input into senior governance forums, steering updates, escalation discussions and leadership reporting where required. • Promote quality, resilience, security, regulatory compliance and control adherence throughout the delivery lifecycle, including ownership of change-control readiness, audit evidence and regulatory delivery obligations where applicable. • Facilitate/participate in Scrum of Scrums or equivalent dependency forums where required and contribute to delivery standards, templates, communities of practice and continuous improvement, with focus on portfolio/workstream alignment, delivery risk visibility and consistent delivery assurance practices. • Create an inclusive, psychologically safe and accountable team environment where constructive challenge, learning and feedback are encouraged. • Mentor less experienced Scrum Masters and delivery colleagues and share reusable practices across the delivery community.

49741ea9.title: Program Manager III, Transportation Financial Systems (TFS)
49741ea9.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) team is looking for a talented and highly motivated Sr. Program Manager who enjoy solving challenging and complex business problems at Amazon scale.  
  
Imagine being a part of a team where every single team member is a critical voice in the decision-making process, has a meaningful impact on product features, and has the ability to re-define the customer experience. Welcome to Transportation Financial Systems (TFS), where we are building multiple financial automation products and functionalities to meet Amazon’s ever-growing finance and accounting customer requirements. You will be in a well-funded, highly technical, and highly visible business critical tech platform team.  
  
We are a technology team focused on building a suite of products for transportation financial systems and beyond that enable Amazon business units (BUs) to add new offerings at scale. Our products abstract complexities from the world of accounting, invoicing, audit, payment, taxation, and allocation at the required level of fidelity and insights to build generic solutions scalable to multiple businesses and geographies. We ensure that financial functions are complete, accurate, timely and compliant with worldwide regulatory and tax requirements. Our software systems include services that handle thousands or requests per second and make decisions to pay billions of dollars a year and ensure that transportation's liabilities and revenues are correctly accounted. Our current team comprises of ~200+ engineering organization and Program management team of 10+ TPMs and Program Managers with great growth and lateral opportunity.  
  
We are looking for a high caliber Senior Program Manager (Sr. PM) who enjoy working on challenging, high impact business problems. The Sr. PM will manage business onboarding to our systems and services, prioritize opportunities in tech systems /process flows and support the functional systems to deliver to defined goals. Successful candidates will be analytical, highly-organized, accustomed to working with technical teams, able to bridge the gap between business and tech, clear communicators, and interested in getting deep into the details of our business. This Program Manager is a high visible role as s/he will front end with Senior Leaders across Amazon Organization.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Sr. PM on the team, you would be responsible for understanding the functional flow of TFS onboarded businesses and key TFS capabilities, required to enable transport finance processes (account payables and receivables) and identifying opportunities to refine both. The Sr. PM will manage the auditing, invoicing, payments products and process with a team of SMEs in TFS and partner teams, identify short term solutions and work with Product/SDM on long term solutions to customer problems. The Sr. PM will evaluate self-serve opportunities to reduce overhead load on TFS, document dashboard or tool requirements and present to TFS Tech team to build consensus for solutions to self-serve on commonly occurring issues. The program manager will work closely with Product/SDM to define the road map. Key responsibilities -
  
  

* Define and manage cross-functional program strategy, including mission, vision, objectives, and measurable success criteria, while driving teams across organizations to deliver on key milestones.
* Analyze data to identify trends, drive improvements, and inform resource allocation decisions — regularly reviewing metrics and proactively seeking new mechanisms for visibility into program health.
* Lead stakeholder alignment through clear written narratives and verbal communication, presenting program updates, trade-offs, and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Identify and mitigate risks proactively, reduce exposure to common failure modes such as unclear requirements or ineffective cross-team collaboration, and solve ambiguous problems with sound judgment.
* Streamline processes and eliminate unnecessary dependencies, partnering with engineering and business teams to prioritize initiatives that improve efficiency and customer outcomes.

  
A day in the life  
TFS has over 200+ engineers, and 20+ product & program managers. Each Program Manager is responsible for delivering large to medium programs; working closely with business teams and product, building transformation roadmaps to deliver long term benefits for our customers.  
  
About the team  
Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) platform owns the technology components that perform the financial activities for Amazon’s transportation business. TFS systems are used across all Amazon’s transportation programs and retail expansion to new geographies. The platform provide financial document creation & management, expense auditing, accounting, payments and cost allocation functions. Our new generation products are highly scalable and operate at finer level granularity to reconcile every dollar in transportation financial accounts with zero manual entries or corrections. The goal is to develop global product suite for all freight modes touching every single package movement across Amazon. Our mission is to abstract logistics complexities from financial world and financial complexities from logistics world. You will be part of one of the largest tech and program team with ~200 engineering organization with great growth and lateral opportunity.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

0d83f9ff.title: Program Manager, WW Returns, WW Returns
0d83f9ff.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

In the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WW R&R) group at Amazon, we are dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ – zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects – to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are an agile and inclusive organization that constantly innovates to create long-term value by investing in our people and our planet, not simply focusing on the bottom line.  
  
WW R&R includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WW R&R, you will partner across these teams to help customers get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.  
  
WW R&R is dedicated to providing the best-in-class refunds experience to customers, by prioritizing faster refunds and ensuring 100% completeness. We strive to build a strong enforcement function to preserve CX, mitigate risk & avoid policy abuse.  
  
We are looking for a seasoned Program Manager who has a passion for working in cross-functional environments, strong communication skills (verbal & written) in addition to proven program management experience. Join us if you want the opportunity to make a big impact in a quickly growing team that can make a big difference in the customers' journey with Amazon.  
  
Amazon is Earth’s most customer-centric company and in WW R&R, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
In this role, you will:  
Create vision, disambiguate complex problem spaces, roadmap, and execution across a suite of refund programs to improve customer trust  
Develop worldwide mechanisms with huge customer-facing and financial impact  
Be a PM, required to collaborate cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business retail teams to design comprehensive, scalable and automated solutions to fulfil the returns policies customers avail and preserve CX.  
  
A day in the life  
You will work with a team of high performing Product/Program Managers, tech counter part on planning and prioritization of product roadmap. You understand the systems and technologies behind your product, their limitations, boundary conditions, and reasons for architectural decisions. You are capable of articulating when a new solution is needed (and when it is not) or discuss the differences between two competing solutions. You proactively mitigate risks and help reduce a program's exposure to failure modes.  
  
About the team  
WW Returns , plays a critical role in the overall Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WW R&R) org by ensuring customers are provided timely and complete refunds. To address this area of paramount importance, we partner with multiple orgs outside WWRR, primarily CS, Ordering, Payments, and internally with Tech & Data Engineering to ensure faster refunds and 100% refund completion across a varying breadth of diverse use-cases and geographies. This IC role serves as a central orchestrator within this strategic workstream, responsible for designing and prioritizing optimal product investments while coordinating end-to-end execution.

* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. 1284c983.title: Sr. Tech Infra Program Manager, OIS NANO
1284c983.description:
**Description**
Operations Infrastructure Services (OIS) provides the technology infrastructure backbone of every Amazon fulfillment site globally — and Quick Commerce is rewriting the rules of how that infrastructure gets built. This role will be the single threaded leader Quick commerce tech infrastructure for an entire country.
  
  
Quick Commerce demands a fundamentally different approach: frugal, vendor-managed infrastructure that launches at unprecedented velocity while maintaining enterprise-grade availability. As the country's single-threaded infrastructure owner, you will define the network and device strategy that enables Amazon to launch and operate hundreds of sites at speed and at a fraction of traditional cost. You will own the country-level technology roadmap, drive vendor relationships, govern availability and financial outcomes, and partner directly with senior business operations leadership. Quick Commerce is the fastest growth vector for Amazon Stores, and team NANO (Network and Assets for Nimble Operations) shapes its technology backbone.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
The NANO TIPM owns the country-level infrastructure strategy — defining architecture standards and readiness criteria against which all site launches execute. For network infrastructure, the TIPM owns end-to-end scope from vendor selection through SLA governance through financial outcome. For End-User Equipment (associate-facing devices such as scanners, workstations, and printers), the TIPM owns identification and recommendation while partnering with Device Tech for certification. The role's responsibilities fall into four themes — Theme 1 sets the framework, Theme 2 executes, Theme 3 governs, and Theme 4 feeds business needs back into Theme 1.
  
  
Theme 1 — Strategy, Vendor Management, and Contract Governance: Own the country's network technology roadmap, drive vendor selection end-to-end, and identify end user devices meeting regional cost and performance targets across all applicable site types.
  
  
Theme 2 — Site Launch and Network Deployment: Define playbooks, architecture standards, and deployment sequencing for the country, stepping in at escalation points where decisions carry fleet-wide implications beyond execution-level authority.
  
  
Theme 3 — Operations Excellence, Governance, and Financial Accountability: Own network availability outcomes, device fleet health, and financial performance across the country's fleet, driving vendor performance through structured governance cadences.
  
  
Theme 4 — Partnership with Business Operations Leadership: Translate the country's business growth priorities into infrastructure strategy, surfacing performance insights, capacity risks, and cost tradeoffs that inform decisions across the region.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You own the network and device technology infrastructure of Quick Commerce in India — the fastest growth vector for Amazon Stores. Your day moves between defining regional network strategy that scales from hundreds to thousands of sites, steering technology capability investments toward fleet-scale readiness, evaluating transitions that deliver cost reduction versus legacy models, and presenting infrastructure roadmaps to senior business operations leadership. You make architecture and vendor decisions that determine availability, cost trajectory, and launch velocity for an entire geography
  
  
**About The Team**
The NANO (Network and Assets for Nimble Operations) team sits within Operations Infrastructure Services and exists to solve a singular challenge: enabling Amazon Operations to launch and operate thousands of small-footprint sites at speed, at scale, and at a fraction of traditional infrastructure cost. The team owns the full infrastructure lifecycle — network strategy, vendor contracts, site launches, incident management, and financial governance — across India, United States, Middle East, United Kingdom, and Japan. Quick Commerce dark stores represent the overwhelming majority of the use cases today, scaling from ~500 sites to 3,000+ by 2028, with the enablement model extending to every emerging no-capex site type in Amazon's portfolio.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
* Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
* Knowledge of information technology infrastructure domains such as compute server platforms, storage server platforms, server components, network devices, technologies and architectures, IT service delivery principles and best practices
* Experience managing conflict, escalations, negotiating compromise, influencing others and problem solving with engineering teams
* Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results, or experience communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience managing large-scale projects from end to end

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a technology field

**Job Title: Mainframe Infrastructure Solution Architect - Presales**
**Location:**
Bengaluru / Chennai / Gurgaon / Pune

Full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Mainframe Infrastructure Architect to join our dynamic team. This pivotal role will be responsible for providing technical leadership and strategic guidance throughout the presales cycle, focusing on mainframe solutions and modernization initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical knowledge of mainframe environments, coupled with exceptional communication and presentation skills to articulate complex solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences, including C-level executives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Solution Design & Architecture:

+ Lead the design and definition of overall mainframe infrastructure solutionframeworks for mainframe components within client proposals and bids.
+ Analyze client requirements, existing IT landscapes, and business objectives to architect tailor-made mainframe solutions, including on-premise, cloud, and hybrid models.
+ Develop detailed architectural designs, high-level designs, and associated documentation (e.g., application views, multiple sections & views, artefacts).
+ Evaluate and recommend solutions to integrate mainframe systems with the broader technology ecosystem.
+ Identify improvements, options, and tradeoffs to define target state solutions.

* Presales & Client Engagement:

+ Act as the primary technical subject matter expert during the presales phase, supporting the sales team in all technical aspects.
+ Engage directly with clients, including C-level executives, technical decision-makers, and business stakeholders, to understand their challenges and demonstrate how our mainframe solutions can address their needs.
+ Develop and deliver compelling technical presentations, demonstrations, and proofs-of-concept (POCs).
+ Collaborate with sales, program/project, and consulting teams to ensure proposed solutions align with client expectations and internal capabilities.
+ Participate in the development of RFP/RFS responses, providing technical analysis, cost estimations, and architectural validation.
+ Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.

* Mainframe Modernization & Innovation:

+ Provide technical and strategic input for mainframe modernization strategies, including re-hosting, refactoring, re-platforming, and rewriting initiatives.
+ Guide customers in planning, evaluating, architecting, and re-engineering legacy applications to leverage modern cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.).
+ Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies (e.g., AI/ML for modernization), and best practices in mainframe and cloud landscapes.
+ Contribute to the development of white papers, case studies, and thought leadership content related to mainframe solutions and modernization.

* Technical Leadership & Mentorship:

+ Provide technical leadership to design, development, and implementation teams for custom solutions.
+ Mentor developers, designers, and junior architects, fostering their growth and enhancing their capabilities.
+ Contribute to internal architecture practices by conducting interviews and sharing knowledge.

* Costing & Risk Management:

+ Develop fully costed solution architectures and provide accurate cost estimates for mainframe solution implementation (such as MFaaS) and ongoing support.
+ Identify implementation risks and potential impacts, proposing mitigation strategies.
+ Validate solutions from a technology, cost structure, and customer differentiation perspective.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Typically 12+ years of experience in a technology environment, with a strong focus on mainframe infrastructure solutions
* Minimum of 5+ years of hands-on technical experience with mainframe systems and technologies such as:

+ Languages: COBOL, JCL, PL/I, Assembler, REXX, Natural, RPG.
+ Databases: DB2 for z/OS, IMS DB, VSAM, Adabas.
+ Transaction Managers: CICS, IMS TM.
+ Operating Systems: z/OS, z/VM, zLinux.
+ Middleware: MQ, WebSphere.
+ Tools: IBM Debug Tool for z/OS, Syncsort, SPUFI, ChangeMan, Endevor, CA-7/ESP/Control-M (Job Schedulers).

* Proven experience in designing and delivering complex mainframe solutions, including large-scale migrations and modernizations.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience in architecting solutions for mainframe to cloud migration/integration and tools like Zowe, OpenShift, Wazi
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to diverse audiences.
* Proven presentation skills, comfortable presenting to large groups and executive levels.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
* Willingness to travel as required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer Engineering / relevant
* Experience with specific mainframe modernization tools and patterns (re-architecture, rewrite, refactor, rehost).
* Familiarity with distributed client-server architecture systems.
* Exposure to GenAI technologies (LLMs, NLP) for application modernization assessments or code transformation.
* Experience with ITILv3 or ITSM principles.

IBM Mainframe administration certification

00be8511.title: Presales Engineer (BFSI)
00be8511.description:
**Company Description**
**Why Join Us**
At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.
  
  
Our prevention-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.
  
  
This is where innovation meets real-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.
  
  
We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.
  
  
What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.
  
  
If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.
  
  
**Your role in a nutshell**
No two days for a Check Point security engineer are the same, from getting hands on with the most advanced technologies in the market, to learning more about the customer’s most pressing security challenges and playing a crucial part in designing a solution, you’re always at the heart of fascinating projects!
  
  
**Job Description**
**Major Responsibilities**

* Winning Sales opportunities by working closely with the partner sales team - identify prospects, progress sales opportunities and help win them demonstrating the Check Point value-proposition
* Present the Check Point story at key forums, including partner led customer events & workshops
* Handholding and jointly conducting POCs and assessments along with partner technical / presales community for prospect customers
* Lead with value-driven conversations with potential and existing customers with ability identify business problems and provide winning solutions
* Become a trusted Cybersecurity advisor for your partner technical community, handling technical questions, presenting Check Point value with the solutions offered
* Demonstrate strong knowledge on Cybersecurity industry developments including tackling competitive threats in sales opportunities
* Help partners respond to RFI’s & RFP’s, share best practices, manage Proof-of-Concepts that translate to best CX through the sales cycle
* Engage and enable key partners and customers on the latest security technologies
* Demonstrate sales acumen through clever positioning of Check Point’s products for optimum cross-sell and Upsell along with partners in their base accounts
* Deliver high impact customer engagements, solution design, winning proposals and uphold the leadership position of Check Point
* Participate and showcase Check Point’s solutions during cyber security events

**Qualifications**
**Desired Background**

* 10+ years of proven experience in technology organizations with over 6 years of direct system engineering and pre-sales experience
* Strong customer centricity with focus on delivering the best experience for customers
* Ability to roll-up the sleeve when required to address gating challenges
* Possess strong analytical and problem solving skills
* Excellent understanding of networking technologies combined with strong understanding of design and applications
* Ability to create an end-to-end security solution for a customer’s environment
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Relevant certifications highly preferred, e.g. CCNP / CISSP/ CCSA / CCSE
* An engineering degree in Computer, Electronics or similar disciplines

2c4bec81.title: Pre-sales Associate
2c4bec81.description:
**Company Description**
XLOUD builds cloud software that runs on a customer's own servers. Enterprises use it to virtualize their data centre, government bodies use it to run private and sovereign clouds, and cloud operators use it to build and sell their own public cloud and GPU services.

The platform covers virtualization, hyperconverged infrastructure, storage, networking, Kubernetes, disaster recovery, migration and log management. Our customers include central government bodies, state utilities, public-sector undertakings and large enterprises in India.

**Roles & Responsibility**

* Track tenders on GeM, eProcurement portals and private RFPs. Read each one fully, prepare the eligibility check, compliance matrix, technical response and bill of quantities, and flag risky clauses early.
* Prepare sizing sheets, proposals, statements of work and rate cards from the approved product catalogue.
* Research competitors: feature comparisons, battle cards, pricing intelligence.
* Create datasheets, one-pagers, case studies and pitch decks within the Xloud brand standards.
* Map target accounts and decision-makers, and build outreach lists.
* Keep the product and competitive knowledge base up to date.
* Every claim must be defensible and every number traceable. Pricing, commercial terms and anything sent to a customer are approved by your manager.

**Pre-requisite**

* MBA in Marketing, Strategy, Operations or Systems. A technical undergraduate degree is a plus.
* 1 to 4 years in presales, bid management, product marketing or enterprise IT sales support. Strong freshers with a technical background will be considered.
* Excellent written English. Most of this job is writing for CXOs and government buyers.
* Good Excel skills: sizing models, comparison tables, cost workings.
* Basic infrastructure knowledge: hypervisors and virtual machines, servers, storage and networking, public versus private cloud, backup and disaster recovery, RPO and RTO.
* Research discipline: find the source, cite it, never guess.
* Ability to handle several deadlines at once.
* Plus points: GeM or public-procurement experience, deck-building ability, comfort using AI tools, prior work in cloud, storage or data-centre businesses.
* This is an in-office role, from Delhi.

d3124d95.title: Sr Solution Sales - AI Platform
d3124d95.description:
Lexsi Lab is a frontier AI research lab and platform company building the
****AI Engineering Layer for mission-critical AI****

. We help enterprises turn open and closed models into
****governed, auditable, production-grade systems****

without vendor or infrastructure lock-in.

Founded by pioneers in deep learning, with research hubs in Mumbai and Paris, Lexsi operates at the intersection of
****AI safety, interpretability, alignment, and systems engineering****

. Our work is published at top-tier venues (ICML, IJCNN, WWW, ACL), and our patented technologies, such as
****DL-Backtrace****

, enable explainability and auditability at a scale that enterprise AI demands.

Our customers deploy AI in environments where failures are expensive, regulation is real, and evidence matters: banking, financial services, insurance, and other high-risk domains.

The Role

We are looking for a
****Senior AI Solutions Architect****

to lead strategic, high-value customer engagements and support large enterprise transactions. This is a senior, customer-facing pre-sales role for someone who combines
****deep AI understanding, system-level thinking, and executive communication skills****

.

You will work closely with sales leadership, researchers, and engineers to shape deals from first conversation to closure. You will regularly engage with CXOs, Heads of AI, Risk, and Engineering, helping them understand how to build
****sovereign, governed, and defensible AI systems****

using Lexsi’s platform and research-led primitives.

This role is not about running delivery projects. It is about
****owning technical credibility in complex sales cycles****

.

What You’ll Do

You will lead technical discovery, solution design, and executive-level presentations for large, multi-stakeholder customers across Europe, the Middle East, and South Asia. You will frame customer problems around AI sovereignty, risk, governance, cost, and control, and translate them into clear architectures and evidence-backed solutions.

You will own the technical narrative in proposals, RFPs, and regulatory questionnaires, working closely with internal research and engineering teams to ensure accuracy, rigor, and feasibility. You will support advanced demos and proofs-of-concept, and help customers understand how Lexsi enables governed LLM gateways, explainability at scale, alignment and fine-tuning pipelines, and runtime observability.

Internally, you will act as the voice of the customer, feeding structured insights back into product, platform, and go-to-market strategy.

Who You Are

You have significant experience working with AI systems and have spent time in
****pre-sales, solution architecture, or technical consulting roles****

tied to complex enterprise deals. You have built or shipped AI products and understand modern ML systems beyond surface-level tooling.

You are comfortable discussing topics such as explainability, alignment, evaluation, and deployment trade-offs with both researchers and senior enterprise stakeholders. You can walk into a high-stakes meeting and clearly explain why governance, auditability, and model optionality matter, without losing the room in technical detail.

You write clearly, present confidently, and operate well in ambiguity. You enjoy shaping solutions rather than following scripts.

Why This Role at Lexsi

You will work at the frontier of
****trustworthy and mission-critical AI****

, influencing how advanced research is adopted in real enterprises. You will play a visible role in large strategic deals and help define how Lexsi is positioned with regulators, banks, and global institutions.

This is a role for someone who wants to sit where
****research, product, and revenue intersect****

, and who enjoys being trusted with conversations that actually matter.

43eaee0c.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

We are looking for an experienced Senior UX/UI Designer who combines exceptional hands-on design expertise with solid leadership capabilities. You will lead complex design initiatives while actively contributing to research, user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity interfaces, prototypes, and scalable design systems.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of creating intuitive, engaging member experiences and transforming complex, large-scale data into clear, actionable interfaces. You will help shape product direction, raise design quality, mentor designers, and collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver measurable user and business outcomes.

This role also requires a forward-looking designer who responsibly applies AI-powered tools, automated workflows, and AI agents to accelerate design and delivery-while maintaining human judgment, data privacy, accessibility, and quality

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Hands-On Design Ownership: Lead end-to-end UX/UI design for complex digital products, from discovery and concept development through detailed interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and implementation review
* Design Leadership & Quality: Set a high standard for usability, visual craft, consistency, and accessibility. Lead design critiques, communicate actionable feedback, and ensure solutions meet user needs and business objectives
* Dashboard & Data Visualization Design: Create intuitive, data-rich dashboards and analytics experiences that help users interpret complex information, identify insights, and take action
* Member Experience: Design cohesive end-to-end journeys, personalized portals, and engagement features that build trust, simplify interactions, and support member retention
* Product Discovery & Strategy: Lead stakeholder workshops, research synthesis, journey mapping, and concept exploration to define problems, prioritize opportunities, and influence product roadmaps
* Figma & Design Systems: Lead the creation and evolution of scalable design systems, including reusable components, design tokens, responsive patterns, documentation, and developer-ready specifications
* AI-Enabled Workflows: Evaluate and apply AI tools and automation to support research synthesis, ideation, wireframing, prototyping, and documentation. Validate outputs and follow organizational privacy and security requirements
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers, Architects, and business stakeholders across time zones to align priorities, resolve trade-offs, and support efficient delivery
* User-Centered & Accessible Design: Champion research-informed decisions, inclusive design, and WCAG-aligned accessibility throughout the product lifecycle
* Mentorship & Team Development: Mentor designers through hands-on guidance, thoughtful feedback, and knowledge sharing to strengthen individual capabilities and overall team quality
* Design Validation & Outcomes: Use usability testing, product analytics, and user feedback to evaluate solutions and improve adoption, task success, engagement, and satisfaction
* Implementation Quality: Collaborate closely with engineering during development, conduct design QA, and ensure delivered experiences reflect the intended interaction and visual quality
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in design or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8+ years of professional UX/UI or product design experience, with a solid portfolio demonstrating hands-on execution, leadership of complex initiatives, and measurable outcomes
* Hands-on experience with AI-enabled design tools and automated workflows, with the judgment to assess output quality, recognize limitations, and protect sensitive information
* Solid hands-on UX/UI expertise across information architecture, user journeys, interaction design, visual design, responsive layouts, prototyping, and usability testing
* Solid experience designing enterprise, SaaS, or other complex web-based products, balancing user needs, business priorities, and technical constraints
* Experience designing complex data dashboards, analytics platforms, and member- or subscriber-based digital experiences
* Experience working in Agile or product-led environments with multidisciplinary teams and distributed stakeholders
* Design system experience, including building, maintaining, and driving adoption of scalable components, design tokens, and reusable UI patterns
* Accessibility knowledge, including practical application of WCAG-aligned design principles and collaboration with engineering to support accessible implementation
* Expert-level Figma proficiency, including advanced prototyping, variables, reusable components, shared libraries, design system architecture, documentation, and Dev Mode handoff
* Data visualization expertise, with the ability to translate complex metrics and workflows into clear, accessible, and actionable experiences
* Demonstrated design leadership, including owning major projects, guiding design decisions, facilitating critiques, mentoring designers, and influencing cross-functional stakeholders
* Demonstrated excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain design rationale, build alignment, and navigate ambiguity

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing healthcare, pharmacy, or other regulated-industry products, with an understanding of privacy, compliance, and complex user needs
* Experience designing AI-powered, conversational, or enterprise search experiences
* Experience leading design across multiple products, workstreams, or distributed teams
* Experience establishing design governance, critique practices, and quality standards
* Experience using experimentation and product analytics to connect design improvements to measurable user and business outcomes
* Familiarity with front-end development concepts and technical constraints to support effective design-engineering collaboration

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

 **Job Purpose**Own the end-to-end technical architecture for Guidewire PolicyCenter implementations, including product model, integration strategy, cloud adoption, non-functional design, and technical governance. dc460d1c.description:
Genpact (NYSE: G) is a global professional services and solutions firm delivering outcomes that shape the future. Our 125,000+ people across 30+ countries are driven by our innate curiosity, entrepreneurial agility, and desire to create lasting value for clients. Powered by our purpose the relentless pursuit of a world that works better for people – we serve and transform leading enterprises, including the Fortune Global 500, with our deep business and industry knowledge, digital operations services, and expertise in data, technology, and AI.

Inviting Applications for the role of **Senior Principal Consultant – Solution Architect - Service Now**

In this role, you will provide technical leadership to the team & work closely with client enterprise architecture team and client ServiceNow Teams

**Responsibilities**

* Provides technical leadership to the team
* Creates and maintains a detailed view of the existing architecture
* Designs and collaboration with Business Process Analysts and Developers in the creation of a High-Level Solution Design Document.
* Defines and communicates, at an architectural and design level, technical solutions aligned with business problems and systems architecture.
* Ensures technical governance process and policies are being adhered to.
* Provides architectural controls to ensure the correct technical solutions are used when delivering business solutions.
* Creates and maintains a detailed view of integrations
* Creates and maintains a Technical Implementation Roadmap.
* Resolves technical escalations, including responding to defects
* Participates in process workshops
* Works closely with client enterprise architecture team and client ServiceNow Teams
* Periodically Reviews Configuration to ensure Platform health
* Assesses instance health (performance, manageability, usability, scalability, upgradability, and security) by conducting ServiceNow Health Scan
* Reviews design and code per sprint to ensure quality
* Provides hands on assistance with the detailed design and implementation approach of selected projects.
* Ensures design is within the boundaries of Licensed modules else communicates changes in license to the client.
* Maintains expert knowledge of the ServiceNow platform, products, capabilities, and ecosystem.
* Assists in migrating configuration across instances
* Support COE in continuous development of training paths for professional advancement.
* Contribute to ongoing definition of best development and solution practices.
* Lead training workshops as means to spread experiences gained across the practice.

**Qualifications we seek in you!**

Minimum Qualifications

* Certified System Administrator (CSA) with two mainline certifications, such as customer service management (CSM), human resources service delivery (HRSD), IT service management (ITSM), governance, risk, and compliance (GRC), or IT operations management (ITOM).
* Experience on S2P, FSO dispute, Service mapping would be preferred.
* Experience in greenfield implementation of two ServiceNow modules, with a strong understanding of their features.
* Proven ability to develop ServiceNow solutions that meet business requirements while adhering to ServiceNow best practices and standards.
* Demonstrated experience in providing technical guidance and leadership to development teams, overseeing the implementation of ServiceNow modules to ensure quality delivery.
* Extensive experience collaborating closely with customer stakeholders, client ServiceNow architects, and enterprise architects.
* Skilled in implementing CMDB, discovery, event management, and service mapping.
* Proficient in preparing high-level design (HLD) and low-level design (LLD) documents.
* Experienced in enabling new features as ServiceNow introduces them.
* Continuously upskill knowledge on ServiceNow features released with each update and patch.
* Ensure designs align with business requirements, maintainability, performance, and overall instance health.
* Familiar with ServiceNow features and experienced in preparing customer proofs of concept (POCs) and demos.
* Excellent communication skills for client-facing roles.

Preferred Qualifications/ Skills

* B.Tech / MCA / M.Tech / BSc (Computer) / B.E.

**Description**
Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) team is looking for a talented and highly motivated Sr. Program Manager who enjoy solving challenging and complex business problems at Amazon scale.
  
  
Imagine being a part of a team where every single team member is a critical voice in the decision-making process, has a meaningful impact on product features, and has the ability to re-define the customer experience. Welcome to Transportation Financial Systems (TFS), where we are building multiple financial automation products and functionalities to meet Amazon’s ever-growing finance and accounting customer requirements. You will be in a well-funded, highly technical, and highly visible business critical tech platform team.
  
  
We are a technology team focused on building a suite of products for transportation financial systems and beyond that enable Amazon business units (BUs) to add new offerings at scale. Our products abstract complexities from the world of accounting, invoicing, audit, payment, taxation, and allocation at the required level of fidelity and insights to build generic solutions scalable to multiple businesses and geographies. We ensure that financial functions are complete, accurate, timely and compliant with worldwide regulatory and tax requirements. Our software systems include services that handle thousands or requests per second and make decisions to pay billions of dollars a year and ensure that transportation's liabilities and revenues are correctly accounted. Our current team comprises of ~200+ engineering organization and Program management team of 10+ TPMs and Program Managers with great growth and lateral opportunity.
  
  
We are looking for a high caliber Senior Program Manager (Sr. PM) who enjoy working on challenging, high impact business problems. The Sr. PM will manage business onboarding to our systems and services, prioritize opportunities in tech systems /process flows and support the functional systems to deliver to defined goals. Successful candidates will be analytical, highly-organized, accustomed to working with technical teams, able to bridge the gap between business and tech, clear communicators, and interested in getting deep into the details of our business. This Program Manager is a high visible role as s/he will front end with Senior Leaders across Amazon Organization.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Sr. PM on the team, you would be responsible for understanding the functional flow of TFS onboarded businesses and key TFS capabilities, required to enable transport finance processes (account payables and receivables) and identifying opportunities to refine both. The Sr. PM will manage the auditing, invoicing, payments products and process with a team of SMEs in TFS and partner teams, identify short term solutions and work with Product/SDM on long term solutions to customer problems. The Sr. PM will evaluate self-serve opportunities to reduce overhead load on TFS, document dashboard or tool requirements and present to TFS Tech team to build consensus for solutions to self-serve on commonly occurring issues. The program manager will work closely with Product/SDM to define the road map. Key responsibilities -
  
  

* Define and manage cross-functional program strategy, including mission, vision, objectives, and measurable success criteria, while driving teams across organizations to deliver on key milestones.
* Analyze data to identify trends, drive improvements, and inform resource allocation decisions — regularly reviewing metrics and proactively seeking new mechanisms for visibility into program health.

* Identify and mitigate risks proactively, reduce exposure to common failure modes such as unclear requirements or ineffective cross-team collaboration, and solve ambiguous problems with sound judgment.
* Streamline processes and eliminate unnecessary dependencies, partnering with engineering and business teams to prioritize initiatives that improve efficiency and customer outcomes.

A day in the life
  
  
TFS has over 200+ engineers, and 20+ product & program managers. Each Program Manager is responsible for delivering large to medium programs; working closely with business teams and product, building transformation roadmaps to deliver long term benefits for our customers.
  
  
**About The Team**
Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) platform owns the technology components that perform the financial activities for Amazon’s transportation business. TFS systems are used across all Amazon’s transportation programs and retail expansion to new geographies. The platform provide financial document creation & management, expense auditing, accounting, payments and cost allocation functions. Our new generation products are highly scalable and operate at finer level granularity to reconcile every dollar in transportation financial accounts with zero manual entries or corrections. The goal is to develop global product suite for all freight modes touching every single package movement across Amazon. Our mission is to abstract logistics complexities from financial world and financial complexities from logistics world. You will be part of one of the largest tech and program team with ~200 engineering organization with great growth and lateral opportunity.

532b42ff.description:
**ANMEDA SYSTEMS PVT. LTD.** **|** **SALES & SOLUTIONS**

**Technical Pre-Sales Engineer / Solution Consultant**  
Industrial Automation, Equipment Digitalization & Manufacturing Software Solutions

**Experience -** 5-8 years

  

**Function -** Technical Pre-Sales / Solutions

  

**Location -** Bengaluru preferred; travel to customer sites across India and overseas as required

  

**Reporting To -** Sales / Solutions Leadership

  

**Industry Focus -** Pharmaceuticals, Life Sciences and Industrial Manufacturing  
   
**Role Purpose**  
We are looking for a technically strong, customer-facing pre-sales professional who can engage with prospective customers, understand their operational and automation challenges, and translate those requirements into practical, technically sound solutions using Anmeda's products, engineering capabilities, and industrial automation expertise. The role will work at the intersection of sales, product, engineering and customer teams and will be responsible for converting business problems into clear solution concepts, architectures, scope and proposals.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Customer Discovery & Requirement Understanding:** Lead technical discussions with customers to understand existing equipment, PLC/HMI/SCADA landscape, data flows, compliance requirements, operational pain points, digitalization objectives and integration needs.
* **Solution Design:** Develop solution concepts and high-level architectures covering equipment upgrades, data acquisition, data centralization, supervisory systems, reporting, integration and compliance requirements.
* **Product Positioning:** Map customer needs to Anmeda offerings such as RetroN21, PharmaSuite/iMEx modules, equipment upgrade services and related automation/digitalization solutions.
* **Technical Proposals:** Prepare solution notes, technical scope, architecture diagrams, assumptions, exclusions, implementation approach, bill of materials inputs and effort estimates in coordination with engineering and commercial teams.
* **Demos & Presentations:** Conduct product demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, technical presentations and workshops for customer engineering, automation, IT, quality, operations and management teams.
* **Site Assessments:** Participate in plant/site visits to assess machines, controls, interfaces, network readiness, data availability and upgrade complexity.
* **Integration Planning:** Define appropriate interfaces with PLCs, HMIs, SCADA/DCS, historians, databases and enterprise applications using technologies such as OPC/OPC UA, industrial protocols, APIs and SQL.
* **Compliance Solutioning:** Understand and articulate requirements related to audit trails, electronic records/e-signatures, user management, data integrity, backup/recovery and regulated manufacturing environments.
* **Sales Support:** Support opportunity qualification, technical objection handling, tender/RFQ responses, proof-of-concept discussions and customer evaluation processes.
* **Internal Handover:** Ensure a structured handover of requirements, commitments, assumptions and proposed architecture to delivery/product teams after order closure.
* **Competitive Understanding:** Maintain awareness of relevant industrial automation and manufacturing software platforms from Rockwell, Siemens, AVEVA, Ignition and other ecosystem players, and clearly position Anmeda's differentiated value.

  

**Required Technical Competencies**

* Good working knowledge of industrial automation systems including PLC, HMI, SCADA and industrial communication networks.
* Hands-on or strong prior exposure to platforms such as Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Mitsubishi, Omron, Schneider, Honeywell or equivalent.
* Understanding of industrial protocols and connectivity such as Ethernet/IP, Modbus TCP/RTU, Profinet, OPC/OPC UA and related interfaces.
* Exposure to databases, SQL, historians, APIs, server/client architecture, virtualization and basic OT/IT networking concepts.
* Ability to understand machine control architectures and assess retrofit/upgrade requirements for legacy and modern equipment.
* Exposure to pharmaceutical/life-sciences manufacturing, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, data integrity or GxP environments is strongly preferred.
* Ability to prepare and explain technical architectures, process flows, scope documents and proposals to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Division Cyber Security Manager

In this role, you will have the opportunity to leverage your cyber security expertise and our cyber security solutions to design resilient industrial systems that empower our customers to operate confidently and securely in a digital world. Be a trusted partner in our journey towards robust cyber defense, fostering a culture of security awareness and proactive risk management. Support the country teams to drive their cyber security business growth within your region.

This role is contributing to the Division Process Industries in AMEA. Main stakeholders are sales, bid & proposals and service teams.

* You are at ease communicating in English.

**More about us:**

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain expertise coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
