36be6b7d.title: Cloud Data Engineer
36be6b7d.description:
Job Title: Cloud Data Engineer – Databricks, dbt Cloud & AWS

**Experience:** 5–8 Years  
**Key Experience:** 5+ years in Databricks and 3+ years in cloud-based data lake/lakehouse architecture  
**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Data Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Databricks, dbt Cloud, and AWS to help build, maintain, and optimize scalable enterprise data platforms.

The ideal candidate will have experience in data engineering, data warehousing, cloud data lake architecture, and enterprise-scale ETL/ELT pipelines. This role involves modernizing legacy data warehouse implementations, converting SQL and PL/SQL business logic into scalable Spark SQL transformations, and developing modular data products using dbt Cloud and dbt Mesh.

The candidate will also contribute to platform reliability, performance tuning, cost optimization, data governance, and automated deployment workflows.

Key Responsibilities

* Analyze existing data warehouse implementations and support migration and consolidation initiatives.
* Reverse-engineer legacy SQL and PL/SQL stored procedures and convert business logic into scalable Spark SQL transformations within Databricks.
* Design and develop AWS-based data lake and lakehouse solutions using S3, Databricks, and Delta Lake.
* Build, maintain, and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion frameworks.
* Develop reusable transformation pipelines using dbt Cloud, including models, tests, macros, incremental models, snapshots, seeds, and documentation.
* Design and manage multi-project dbt Mesh architectures, including cross-project references, model contracts, model versioning, and access controls.
* Configure and maintain dbt Cloud environments, jobs, deployment schedules, and CI checks across development, QA, and production.
* Optimize data models, including Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, flattened models, and modern lakehouse approaches.
* Tune Spark and Databricks workloads through partitioning, query optimization, performance improvements, and cost management.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to data lakes, pipelines, scheduled jobs, and data processing.
* Perform foundational data administration activities, including job scheduling, error troubleshooting, and backup coordination.
* Collaborate with data architects and cross-functional teams to align ingestion and transformation frameworks with enterprise standards.
* Maintain GitHub repositories, manage branching and merging strategies, review pull requests, resolve merge conflicts, and support release management.
* Build and maintain CI/CD workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions for automated testing and deployment of dbt and Databricks code.
* Document ETL processes, data flows, transformation logic, and technical solutions.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, retrospectives, backlog grooming, and iterative delivery.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* 5–8 years of overall experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or big data platform development.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with Databricks, including Spark SQL, PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows/Jobs, and performance optimization.
* Strong practical experience with dbt Cloud, including models, tests, Jinja macros, incremental models, snapshots, jobs, environments, and deployments.
* Experience with dbt Mesh, including multi-project architecture, cross-project references using ref(), model contracts, versioning, and governance/access controls.
* Strong knowledge of AWS data services, including S3, Glue, Lambda, IAM, Step Functions, and CloudWatch; exposure to Redshift or EMR is beneficial.
* At least 3 years of experience designing and implementing cloud-based data lake or lakehouse architectures using Databricks.
* Strong understanding of Spark technologies, including Spark SQL, PySpark, or Scala.
* Advanced SQL and PL/SQL skills, including the ability to analyze, understand, and refactor legacy stored procedures.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and enterprise-scale ETL/ELT pipeline development.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language: Python, Scala, or Java.
* Experience with performance tuning, partitioning strategies, scalability, and cloud cost optimization.
* Strong GitHub skills, including branching, merging, pull requests, code reviews, and repository management.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD and DevOps practices for data engineering workflows, preferably using GitHub Actions.
* Experience working in Agile project environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

* Databricks Associate or Professional certification.
* dbt Analytics Engineering certification.
* Experience with enterprise data governance, metadata management, and data catalog platforms such as Unity Catalog.
* Exposure to AWS Redshift and EMR.

What We Are Looking For

A hands-on Cloud Data Engineer who can modernize legacy data platforms, develop reliable data products, implement scalable dbt and Databricks solutions, and collaborate effectively with architects and cross-functional teams.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at **hr@spasnik.com** or reach out via direct message.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana

ebe3d495.title: Senior Staff Security Architect
ebe3d495.description:
### **About Us**

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

### **Reports To**

Director, AI & Information Security

**Role Summary** We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Senior Staff Cyber Security Architect to design, implement, and govern security architecture across enterprise networks, endpoints, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and AI ecosystems. This role is critical to establishing security standards, driving secure-by-design initiatives, and ensuring our technology landscape remains resilient against evolving cyber threats. You will serve as a trusted technical leader, bridging business and technology to enable innovation through secure, scalable architecture.

**What You Will Be Doing**
  
As a Senior Staff Architect, you will define and maintain the enterprise-wide security architecture, standards, and reference designs. You will lead security reviews for infrastructure, cloud, SaaS, and emerging AI initiatives while enforcing Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust principles. Success in your first 6–12 months includes developing a cohesive security roadmap, establishing robust AI and cloud security guardrails, and partnering cross-functionally across Engineering, IT, and Product teams to reduce critical risks while elevating our overall security maturity.

**What You Will Bring to ChargePoint**

* **Define and maintain** enterprise-wide security architecture, standards, and reference designs across network, endpoint, cloud, SaaS, and AI domains.
* **Architect and govern** secure cloud landing zones, security guardrails, and DevSecOps shift-left practices across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
* **Establish and enforce** Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust Architecture principles, ensuring secure connectivity, micro-segmentation, and least-privilege access.
* **Lead the development** of our enterprise AI security strategy, establishing controls for Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), model poisoning detection, and responsible AI governance.
* **Design** enterprise network and endpoint security architecture, overseeing standards for NGFW, ZTNA, EDR, MDM, and secure SD-WAN.
* **Oversee** SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) and establish comprehensive controls for enterprise platforms (e.g., M365, Salesforce, Workday).
* **Develop** robust Identity & Access Management (IAM) strategies, including SSO, MFA, Privileged Access Management (PAM), and passwordless authentication.
* **Conduct** comprehensive architecture reviews, threat modeling, and security assessments to identify risks and recommend strategic remediation to executive leadership.
* **Partner cross-functionally** with Engineering, Product, IT, and Legal teams to integrate security throughout the development lifecycle and align with regulatory frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).
* **Provide architectural guidance** during major cyber incidents, partnering with SOC and Incident Response teams to evaluate events and strengthen future security controls.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of comprehensive cybersecurity experience, with at least 5+ years in a Security Architect or Lead Security Engineering role supporting enterprise-scale global environments.
* Deep technical expertise across network, endpoint, SaaS, cloud, and emerging AI security domains.
* Proven track record of designing and implementing Zero Trust Architectures and managing enterprise risk.
* Experience developing secure cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and implementing DevSecOps practices.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the courage and ability to influence cross-functional leadership on security best practices.
* **Education Requirements:** B.Tech/B.E. in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, or GIAC.
* Cloud-specific security certifications (e.g., AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer Associate, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer).
* Experience or certifications related to AI/LLM Security (e.g., CAISP) and data privacy (CIPP).
* Master's degree in a relevant technical or engineering field.

**Location**
  
Gurgaon/Bangalore, India — Hybrid / Remote

We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company needs, we will contact you directly.

ChargePoint is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that welcomes and supports all qualified individuals. In alignment with this commitment, we ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations throughout the employment process.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, or to access any other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact us at **accommodations@chargepoint.com**.

ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer.  
Applicants only - Recruiting agencies do not contact.

* Review and govern business process documentation, functional and technical specifications, test strategies, and go-live readiness plans.
* Collaborate with global ERP teams, business stakeholders, IT partners, infrastructure teams, and deployment teams to deliver successful business outcomes.
* Partner with solution providers, process owners, architects, and key users to execute project deliverables and support deployment methodologies.
* Continuously optimize planning processes and system performance by identifying improvement opportunities and delivering scalable, business-aligned solutions, including support for quarterly SAP IBP releases and enhancements.

**What you need:**

* 10-13 years of experience delivering SAP full lifecycle implementations, with a proven track record of successful project execution.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with SAP IBP and/or SAP APO, including integration across end-to-end planning and supply chain processes.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused solutions.
* Familiarity with ITIL, Agile methodologies, and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices, with the ability to work across data, integration, security, and reporting domains.
* Demonstrated success collaborating within global, cross-functional, and matrixed organizations, ideally within the medical device, pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated industries.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.
* You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‑driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

You are a highly technical hands on individual who is passionate about exploring and applying Pega technology to help solve business problems.
  
  

* Minimum 6 years of Pega experience and CSSA certification and experience in building and implementing model-driven, enterprise-level business solutions.
* Excellent time management and organization skills, with the capability to manage multiple competing priorities

9a70b84c.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
9a70b84c.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
  
  
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

a8bc3a03.title: Senior Solution Architect
a8bc3a03.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Migration Architect to lead complex Data Centre Exit and DC Consolidation programmes, migrating large-scale enterprise estates to Amazon Web Services (AWS). This is a technically demanding, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of cloud architecture, migration engineering, and programme delivery.
  
  
You will be responsible for the end-to-end architectural direction of migration programmes — from initial discovery and dependency mapping through to wave execution, cutover, and post-migration optimisation. You will bring deep expertise in AWS infrastructure, licensing portability (BYOL, BYOS, AWS Licence Manager), network transformation using AWS Transit Gateway and Direct Connect, and the unique complexities that arise when exiting or consolidating physical data centres onto AWS.
  
  
This role is suited to an architect who is equally comfortable whiteboarding a target-state AWS Landing Zone architecture with a CTO and sitting with an engineering team to resolve a blast-radius dependency conflict the night before a cutover.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Design and own the target-state cloud architecture for DC Exit / DC Consolidation programmes on AWS, including compute (EC2, ECS, EKS), storage (EBS, EFS, S3), networking (VPC, Transit Gateway), identity (IAM, AWS SSO), and security (AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, SCPs)
* Lead application and infrastructure discovery using AWS Application Discovery Service (ADS), Migration Evaluator, and dependency mapping to produce migration-ready groupings and blast radius analysis
* Define migration patterns (rehost via AWS MGN, replatform to RDS/EKS, refactor to Lambda/containers, retire, replace with SaaS) per workload with clear technical rationale and risk assessment
* Produce Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), High-Level Designs (HLDs), and Low-Level Designs (LLDs) to programme-grade quality, aligned to the AWS Well-Architected Framework
* Govern architectural consistency across migration waves and enforce AWS Landing Zone / Control Tower guardrails throughout the transition

**Licensing Portability & Compliance**

* Lead licensing portability strategy for DC exit — BYOL (Bring Your Own Licence) for Windows Server and SQL Server on EC2, AWS Licence Manager configuration, OEM licence impact analysis, and SPLA transition planning for MSP-operated environments moving to AWS
* Advise on AWS Dedicated Hosts as the mechanism for BYOL compliance for Windows Server and SQL Server (per-socket/per-core licence models), ensuring licence counts are correctly mapped to Dedicated Host instance families
* Design licence governance controls using AWS Licence Manager rules, resource tagging strategies via AWS Config, and integration with third-party SAM tooling (Flexera, Snow Software) to prevent compliance drift post-migration
* Engage the AWS account team and AWS Partner Network (APN) to maximise programme value through AWS Migration Acceleration Programme (MAP) funding, AWS Credits, and AWS Professional Services co-delivery

**Network Transformation**

* Design target-state hybrid network architectures on AWS: AWS Transit Gateway (TGW) as the centralised routing hub, AWS Direct Connect (dedicated and hosted connections), Site-to-Site VPN as failover, and SD-WAN integration with TGW Connect
* Define internet egress and traffic inspection strategy for the post-DC state, replacing DC-based security perimeters with AWS Network Firewall, AWS Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) with third-party NVAs (Palo Alto, Fortinet), and AWS WAF
* Lead DNS transformation planning — Amazon Route 53 Private Hosted Zones, Route 53 Resolver (inbound/outbound endpoints), split-horizon DNS — and IP addressing strategy for migration with minimal re-IP using AWS IPAM
* Design VPC architecture across accounts and regions: hub-and-spoke or flat TGW models, VPC sharing via AWS RAM, and PrivateLink for service consumption without public exposure
* Ensure latency-sensitive workloads (ERP, payments, OT/SCADA) are isolated in dedicated VPCs with appropriate Direct Connect SIFs and QoS, and their connectivity requirements validated pre-cutover

**Migration Programme Delivery**

* Own the migration wave plan using AWS Migration Hub as the central tracking plane — sequencing, dependency groupings, rollback criteria, and cutover playbooks across programmes of 500+ workloads
* Lead rehost migrations using AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) for agent-based lift-and-shift, and AWS Server Migration Service (SMS) or AWS VMware Cloud on AWS (VMC) for VMware estate migration
* Define and enforce go/no-go criteria for each migration wave, including pre-flight AWS MGN replication lag thresholds, post-cutover smoke test suites, and DNS TTL management during cutover windows
* Manage and resolve technical blockers across infrastructure, networking, security, and application teams during wave execution
* Ensure regulated workloads (financial services, public sector) are handled with appropriate regulatory notifications, BCP/DR evidence updated in AWS Resilience Hub, and audit trails via AWS CloudTrail

**FinOps & Cost Governance**

* Build pre-migration cost models using AWS Migration Evaluator and AWS Pricing Calculator, incorporating BYOL savings on Dedicated Hosts, Savings Plans and Reserved Instance pricing, S3 storage tiering, and data transfer / egress cost assumptions
* Establish a FinOps operating model — visibility via AWS Cost Explorer and Cost and Usage Reports (CUR), accountability through AWS account-level tagging and chargeback, optimisation via Compute Optimizer and Savings Plans, governance via AWS Budgets and anomaly detection
* Conduct post-migration right-sizing reviews using AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations and Trusted Advisor checks to close the gap between business case projections and actual AWS spend

**Stakeholder & Vendor Management**

* Act as the primary technical authority for client stakeholders up to CTO / CIO level, translating complex AWS architectural decisions into clear business outcomes
* Lead multi-vendor technical governance — defining interface agreements, RACI frameworks, and joint testing protocols across SIs, MSPs, and AWS
* Manage AWS account team, network vendors (Direct Connect providers, SD-WAN), and third-party migration tooling vendors as an integrated programme team

**Essential**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in cloud architecture, with a significant portion focused on large-scale migration programmes (DC Exit, DC consolidation, or cloud-first transformation) on AWS
* Deep hands-on expertise in AWS compute and migration services: EC2 (including Dedicated Hosts for BYOL), AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), AWS Migration Hub, AWS Application Discovery Service (ADS), and AWS Database Migration Service (DMS)
* Demonstrable expertise in AWS licensing portability: BYOL on Dedicated Hosts (Windows Server and SQL Server per-socket/per-core models), AWS Licence Manager configuration, OEM licence restrictions, and SPLA transition planning for MSP colo environments
* Network transformation experience: AWS Transit Gateway, Direct Connect (dedicated and hosted), VPC design (hub-and-spoke, shared VPCs), Route 53 Resolver, AWS Network Firewall, and SD-WAN integration with TGW Connect
* Proven experience designing and executing migration wave plans for estates of 500+ VMs in enterprise or regulated environments, using AWS Migration Hub as the tracking plane
* AWS Landing Zone / Control Tower design and guardrail enforcement across multi-account organisations
* FinOps experience: AWS Cost Explorer, Cost and Usage Reports (CUR), Compute Optimizer, Savings Plans, and pre-migration cost modelling using AWS Migration Evaluator
* Strong technical documentation skills — ADRs, HLDs, LLDs, cutover playbooks, and AWS Well-Architected Review outputs to consulting-grade standard
* Experience operating in multi-vendor programme environments (SI, MSP, AWS account team triangles)

**Highly Desirable**

* Hands-on experience with VMware Cloud on AWS (VMC on AWS) as a migration accelerator for VMware-heavy DC estates
* Experience with AWS Outposts for hybrid workloads that cannot fully exit on-prem, and AWS Local Zones for latency-sensitive edge workloads
* Experience with third-party migration tooling: Zerto on AWS, Carbonite Migrate, CloudEndure (now MGN), or PlateSpin
* Container and modernisation experience: Amazon EKS, Amazon ECS, AWS App2Container (A2C) for containerising legacy applications during DC exit
* Azure exposure — useful for programmes with workloads that are split across hyperscalers

**Certifications**
**Certification**
**Status**
**Notes**
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional Required Core requirement at this level AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate Expected Assumed as prerequisite to Professional AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty Highly Desirable Essential for network transformation-heavy programmes AWS Certified Security – Specialty Highly Desirable For regulated and public sector programmes AWS Cloud Practitioner Expected Foundational — assumed at this level TOGAF / ArchiMate Desirable Enterprise architecture governance contexts Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) Desirable For multi-cloud or Azure-adjacent programmes
  
  
**Competency Framework**
**Competency**
**Behavioural Indicators at Senior Level**
Technical Depth Provides technically precise answers without being prompted; anticipates second-order consequences of architectural decisions Risk Ownership Proactively surfaces programme risks before they become issues; defines rollback criteria and escalation paths without being asked Stakeholder Influence Can translate technical complexity into business language for C-suite; influences without authority across vendor teams Delivery Pragmatism Makes pragmatic trade-off decisions under time pressure; knows when 'good enough now' beats 'perfect later' Continuous Learning Stays current with AWS service releases and deprecations; proactively shares knowledge with programme teams and clients via internal tech talks or runbook updates
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Lead architect role on high-visibility, enterprise-scale DC Exit programmes for FTSE 100 and public sector clients on AWS
* Direct access to AWS Migration Acceleration Programme (MAP) funding, AWS ProServe co-delivery, and AWS account team engineering support
* Structured career progression into Principal Architect or Cloud Practice Lead roles
* Certification support — AWS exam costs, study leave, and training budget (A Cloud Guru / Pluralsight / re:Invent access)
* Hybrid working model — programme site presence balanced with remote working
* Competitive salary, performance bonus, and pension scheme

0459a217.title: Senior Systems Engineer (Pre Sales)
0459a217.description:
**Company Description**
Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
  
  
At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
  
  
Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Who You'll Work With**
When you join Arista as part of the Sales Engineering team, you're not just stepping into a role, you're becoming part of a team of industry experts and technical leaders. Typically reporting to the System Engineering Manager, you'll be working alongside some of the most skilled field engineers in the industry. Our team prides itself on not just understanding the technology but also the business impact and aligning our solutions with the larger goals of our clients. In collaboration with our Product Management and Software Development teams, you will play a pivotal role in steering product developments, offerings, and strategic direction to best serve our customers and prospects. Supported by the expertise of our world class Arista TAC, cutting-edge proof-of-concept resources, and support of the executive team, you are well-positioned to lead and innovate within the industry.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
We are experiencing tremendous growth and have an immediate need for a collaborative, self-motivated Senior Systems Engineer to partner with our Account teams to provide pre-sales technical systems engineering support for our enterprise/commercial customers in the Western India area.
  
  

* The Systems Engineer is a critical component of the Arista Sales team with the key responsibility of acting as a trusted advisor for our customers to gather requirements and identify opportunities with existing and new customers.
* You will partner with the Arista Account Managers to understand customer pain points and conduct white board network architectural reviews in addition to conducting Arista product presentations of Arista’s Open Networking Data Centre and Cognitive Campus (including Wi-fi) networking solutions, CloudVision (Network Automation), Security (Network Detection & Response), Endpoint Security and Real-time Fabric Monitoring solutions.
* You will architect, design and propose Arista Data Centre & Campus network solutions using leaf-spine architectures (VxLAN, EVPN) and network overlays to capture additional sales.
* Perform hands-on tests to validate customer proof-of-concept setups, Data Centre and/or Campus network designs, and network deployments using new products and features
* Put together design guidelines and recommend improvements to customers for the networks they support
* Partner with Sales Team to respond to RFP/RFQs
* Provide feedback to Product Management and Engineering
* Represent Arista at SDN and Open Networking industry events and conferences
* Keep up-to-date on competitive solutions, products, and services
* Author white papers on technology and product.

**Qualifications**

* BE/BS/CS/CE technical degree required
* Network Industry Certification preferred (e.g. CCIE (R&S), JNCIE)
* You possess a minimum of 10+ years of L2/L3 networking design and implementation experience with a focus on Data Centre and Campus networks.
* You possess expert level expertise in routing and switching including L2/L3 protocols (Cisco, Juniper, Extreme, Aruba)
* Demonstrated work experience as either a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales SE or Network Consulting Engineer preferred
* Previous experience with network overlays preferred.
* Expert knowledge in three or more of the following areas: Ethernet, RSTP/ MSTP, VLANs, IP Routing, TCP/IP, BGP, eBGP, VxLAN, EVPN, Multicast, Spanning Tree, QoS
* Expert-level knowledge of industry-standard CLI
* Experience with SDN and Network Function Virtualization (NFV) highly desired.
* Previous experience building network automation using Python and Ansible desired.
* Knowledge of competitive products, solutions, and services
* Ability to write white papers a plus.

**Additional Information**
Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
  
  
We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
  
  
Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature.
  
  
Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India’s first AI-enabled state-of-the-art Semiconductor Packaging facility . This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence.
  
TSAT is a subsidiary of the Tata group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust.’

  

**Job Description:**

  

A Server Lead will be primarily responsible for:

* New server & Storage deployments

* Lead Enterprise Computing operations

* Meet the operations support with the expansion in Infrastructure

* Ensure server related requirements and incidents are addressed on time.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **New Server deployment (20%)**

* + Understand the IT infra requirement and work on preparing plan for deployment. Based on the Business requirements, prepare BoQ in early stages to help in placing the order.
  + To be a part of technical evaluation of solution and technologies.
  + Coordinate with the OEM/Partner for planning and deployment of solutions on time

* **Enterprise Computing Operations Management (40%)**

* Manage the support operations and ensure the reported issues are addressed on time
* Handle escalations and manage to resolve the escalated incidents.
* Ensure the availability of servers & Storage and coordinate with required teams to fix any issues.
* Manage shift Roster for the team to ensure support coverage
* Ensure devices availability is monitored, and any health alerts are addressed immediately
* Monitor and manage the Data Centre operations
* Maintain a checklist for routine health check of the Enterprise Compute Infra
* Ensure scheduled reports are monitored and necessary actions are taken against them.

* **Compliance & Security (10%)**

* Ensure the server Infra and endpoints are complaint with the ES security controls
* Ensure periodic Audits and Vulnerability assessment is performed on the Network devices and ensure the findings are remediated
* Ensure the device inventory is updated and a monthly compliance checklist is published
* Visit Data Centre to ensure all Data Centre controls are working and work with internal team for quarterly testing of the controls
  

* **Incident & Change Management (10%)**

* Need to front end the critical incidents, evaluate the RCA and follow up for the preventive action closures
* Need to ensure change controls are followed and unauthorised changes are prevented
* Ensure all Changes are documented in the ITSM tool, Review the change plan impact
* Ensure the agreed SLA is met for Enterprise Computing operations
  

* **Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery (10%)**

* Be a part of DR/BCP planning for Enterprise computing devices and plan for meeting the RPO /RTO defined
* Ensure business continuity in case devices failures (Ensure devices backup is available, required standby devices are available and support team is aligned for replacement)
  

* **Documentation (10%)**

* Review and version-control critical documents
* Incorporate any server infra changes into documentation
* Ensure accessibility for the team when required.
  

**Qualification & Work Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or an equivalent qualification
* Any Profession certifications in Servers, Virtualisation platform, storage will be an added advantage
* 10–12 years of experience with prior lead experience and Data Centre operations
* Experience managing large IT infrastructure; manufacturing domain exposure is an advantage
  

**Key Interaction requirements:**

* With DRI from all internal units - to understand and fulfil IT related business requests, troubleshoot any issues they report
* With Other Internal Digital Teams to understand and fulfil IT related business requests & collaborate with them to troubleshoot
* With Internal Teams to handle operations management
* With external OEM/Vendors to troubleshoot, support, Service level reviews & escalations.

dd2b579a.title: Technical Solution Architect – IoT & Protection Automation - Switchgear
dd2b579a.description:
Role Overview
  
  
The Technical Solution Architect is responsible for designing and implementing IoT solutions for brownfield environments, focusing on electrical switchgear and other electrical assets. The role involves collaborating with customers to understand requirements, developing innovative solution architectures, optimizing existing infrastructure, and ensuring seamless integration of IoT devices within the electrical ecosystem.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop best practices for retrofitting and integrating IoT technologies into existing electrical infrastructure.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software developers and hardware engineers, to deliver end-to-end solutions.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations related to electrical safety and data privacy.
* Provide pre-sales support by preparing technical proposals, delivering presentations, and participating in client meetings.
* Research emerging trends in IoT and electrical systems to enhance solution architecture and drive technological advancements.
* Develop detailed solution documentation, including architecture diagrams, technical specifications, and implementation guidelines.
* Lead proof-of-concept (PoC) projects to demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of proposed solutions.
* Evaluate third-party products and services to identify opportunities for enhancing IoT architectures.
* Support project scoping, timeline planning, budgeting, and risk mitigation to ensure timely delivery.
* Act as a subject matter expert during customer interactions, providing technical guidance, industry best practices, and recommendations for improvement.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Instrumentation, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in solution architecture, particularly in IoT and electrical systems.
* Strong knowledge of electrical equipment, including switchgear, transformers, and sensors.
* Experience in designing and deploying solution architectures.
* Proficiency in IoT communication protocols, data security, and cloud connectivity.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively in multiple languages.

SAP BASIS & S/4HANA Presales- SAP Senior Domain Architect | FJ11
  
  
**Experience-**
8–12 years in SAP BASIS and HANA, including presales or solution architecture experience.
  
  
**Core focus**
SAP ERP and S/4HANA architecture, conversion, migration, cloud, sizing, operations, resilience, and managed services.
  
  
**Platforms**
Azure, AWS, GCP, on-premises, and hybrid SAP environments.
  
  
**Key landscape**
S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Fiori, HANA, Solution Manager, SAP cloud technologies, and integrated applications.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Lead end-to-end SAP BASIS and S/4HANA technical presales, shaping secure, scalable, resilient, and commercially viable architecture across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid landscapes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own technical presales from discovery and landscape assessment through architecture, sizing, estimation, proposal, client presentation, bid defense, negotiation support, and delivery handover.
* Design SAP ERP and S/4HANA target architectures, transformation of roadmaps, implementation and conversion approaches, and cloud or hybrid operating models.
* Lead S/4HANA readiness, system conversion, OS/DB migration, homogeneous and heterogeneous migration, DMO, installation, upgrade, patching, system copy, and cutover planning.
* Create SAP landscape and infrastructure designs covering compute, HANA sizing, network, storage, security, access, backup and recovery, high availability, disaster recovery, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Shape SAP workloads on Azure, AWS, and GCP, including migration strategy, resilience, platform operations, and cost-conscious architecture decisions.
* Provide architecture guidance across S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Fiori, HANA, Solution Manager, SAP cloud technologies, and application or data integration.
* Define SAP BASIS managed-services solutions including L2/L3 support, platform administration, service governance, automation, DevOps, observability, continuous improvement, and operational readiness.
* Develop technical solution artifacts, assumptions, dependencies, risks, effort estimates, staffing inputs, migration waves, service descriptions, and statement-of-work content.
* Support deal governance, and strengthen reusable standards, reference architectures, accelerators, and knowledge assets.

**Essential Skills**

* Deep SAP BASIS, HANA, NetWeaver, Solution Manager, and S/4HANA technical architecture expertise.
* Practical experience in SAP implementation, conversion, migration, upgrades, cloud hosting, sizing, HA/DR, backup and recovery, monitoring, and performance engineering.
* Understanding operating systems, databases, networks, storage, cloud infrastructure, security, integration, and SAP DevOps toolchains.
* Strong presales capability in solution storytelling, estimation, RFP responses, architecture documentation, customer workshops, executive presentations, and technical negotiation.
* Ability to convert complex technical findings into pragmatic roadmaps, clear options, measurable outcomes, controlled risks, and executable delivery plans.

**Qualifications & Attributes**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Minimum one end-to-end S/4HANA conversion or major SAP transformation; relevant conversion, HANA, cloud, or migration certification is preferred.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, documentation, communication, customer engagement, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Self-directed, quality focused, collaborative, and able to lead cross-functional teams with limited supervision.
* Strong customer service orientation with commitment to service quality, continuous improvement, mentoring, and knowledge sharing.

**Soft Skills & Success Measures**

* Excellent written, oral, presentation, facilitation, and executive stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, estimation, decision-making, and structured problem-solving capability.
* Quality-oriented mindset with disciplined production of proposals, architectures, estimates, assumptions, and delivery-ready artifacts.
* Collaborative team players who can mobilize matrix teams, manage competing priorities, and work effectively across cultures and time zones.

We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

* Strong understanding of infrastructure including storage, networking, and cloud platforms

1. **Analytical Thinking**

* Ability to evaluate complex variables and determine effective approaches
* Applies structured problem-solving with sound technical judgment

1. **Adaptability**

* Comfort working in ambiguous environments with evolving requirements
* Adjusts approach based on customer and project needs

1. **Communication & Influence**

* Effectively communicates technical concepts to diverse audiences
* Uses persuasion and context to influence decisions within and across teams

* Demonstrated ability to execute migrations using established tools and methodologies
* Familiarity with end-to-end migration lifecycle including discovery, planning, execution, and validation

**2. Unstructured Data & NAS Fundamentals**

**Architecture & Documentation**

b9f290f4.title: Oracle Cloud Technical Consultant ( Mid Level )
b9f290f4.description:
**Company Description**

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.

We’re an award-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:

* UK & Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft & Oracle partner
* 3300+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland & UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK & Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW

We’re a core valuesdriven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you.

 **Job Description**

**Role Overview**

Be part of Version 1’s Managed Services team as an Oracle Cloud Technical Consultant with a focus on Oracle Integration Cloud and Reporting technologies. This opportunity is ideal for professionals who excel in Oracle’s reporting technologies like OIC, BIP, OTBI and customer support, ensuring our enterprise clients receive actionable data and seamless reporting operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and support integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) including app-driven, scheduled, and file-based integrations.
* Build integrations with REST and SOAP services connecting Oracle Fusion Cloud and other platforms.
* Troubleshoot integration issues, perform root cause analysis, and provide day-to-day support for live integrations.
* Implement error handling, retry mechanisms, and monitor OIC flows for performance and reliability.
* Collaborate with functional teams and clients to analyze integration requirements and deliver scalable solutions.
* Design, develop, and maintain reports and dashboards using Oracle BI Publisher, OTBI, and Oracle Analytics Cloud tools.
* Build custom and ad hoc reports for Oracle Fusion Cloud (ERP/HCM/SCM) modules, based on customer requirements.
* Support and troubleshoot issues in reporting solutions for live business environments and provide end-user support for report-related queries.
* Partner with business analysts and stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Optimize report performance, manage data extract processes, and ensure data integrity through testing and validation.
* Create and maintain documentation for developed reports, data models, and workflows.
* Participate in Oracle Cloud quarterly release impact assessments relating to reports and analytics.

  
**Qualifications**

* **Required Qualifications**
* 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and Oracle Cloud technologies and reporting technologies like BI Publisher, OTBI etc
* Experience developing data extracts using BICC, FBDI, HDL, and other Oracle Cloud data interfaces.
* Strong skills in SQL, PL/SQL, and building analytical reports or dashboards for Oracle Fusion Cloud modules.
* Familiarity with the Oracle Cloud data model, subject areas, and reporting security configurations.
* **Preferred Skills**
* Experience supporting managed services environments and handling user support tickets for reporting.
* Exposure to Oracle SaaS/ERP data integrations and migration strategies.
* Knowledge of security best practices for reporting and sensitive data outputs.
* ITIL process knowledge is a plus.
* **Communication & Teamwork**
* Excellent verbal and written communication to interact with clients and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to prioritize multiple reporting requests and manage deliverables under tight deadlines.
* Strong problem-solving mindset and willingness to document and share knowledge with colleagues.
* Knowledge of Oracle Fusion modules, interface tables, and data mapping logic.
* Proven troubleshooting ability and a methodical approach to report optimization and validation.
* Familiarity with version control (Git/GitHub), CI/CD processes, and technical design documentation.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.

  
**Additional Information**

b27060ad.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.

Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.

Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

### **Your Task**

This role is for a **Customer Delivery Manager (CDM)** who is accountable for the end-to-end delivery for customer accounts or cluster of accounts with a focus on quality and cost. The position serves as the delivery liaison between the customer and the delivery organization (e.g., CS, CMS). This role requires fostering strong collaboration and direct communication with the Service Management (CSM) organization and both internal and external delivery units/suppliers.

#### **Responsibilities**

* **Service Delivery:** Oversee end-to-end delivery operations model of the contracted cloud services for customers, balancing cost and quality across cloud service offerings
* **Team Leadership:** Lead and manage a team of CDMs/squads, integrating SC, OPM, and additional roles such as quality or program managers where required
* **Collaboration & Communication:** Maintain regular communication with delivery teams and suppliers regarding performance and quality, and establish regular cadence with Service Management (CSM) and customers on delivery aspects
* **Customer Advocacy:** Represent the voice of the customer within the CMS delivery organization
* **Solution Approval:** Endorse and approve optimal costing and solution design sign-off, including Transition/Transformation (TT) approach
* **Delivery Oversight:** Monitor all aspects of customer delivery ensuring services are delivered on time, within budget, and with high quality
* **Cost & Quality Management:** Supervise and monitor the quality and cost of services in adherence to customer order/contract obligations and drive cost optimization and efficiency measures
* **Addressing Portfolio Gaps:** Identify and address any service gaps in collaboration with portfolio owners
* **Escalation Management:** Serve as escalation point for quality of service delivery issues or customer concerns
* **Complaint Management:** Ensure prompt management and resolution of customer delivery complaints
* **Quality Enhancement:** Direct quality initiatives like Back2Green programs in alignment with QPEE process and standards
* **Strategic Planning:** Periodically review and align with Service Delivery Management (CSM) the customer strategy for optimizing customer delivery
* **Business Alignment:** Maintain oversight of company business imperatives and actively contribute to Cloud Services business objectives and strategic initiatives

#### **Decision Authority**

Within the framework of the company's goals, guidelines, and objectives for cloud services, this role has the authority to independently make decisions regarding delivery model aspects for assigned customers. This includes considerations related to the delivery model, cost/quality of services, and ongoing development and delivery model optimization for existing customers as well as their implementation. For new offerings, in accordance with the Sales Solution Design Process, this role is responsible for solution design sign-off of the CS service offering delivery model and associated costs.

4a7ca7b8.title: WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager
4a7ca7b8.description:
WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager

**We offer:**
=============

The WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager combines two equally important responsibilities within KION's Enterprise Network service. Approximately 50% of the role governs the global WAN managed service, and approximately 50% coordinates service delivery and BAU operations across Campus LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN and DDI.

For WAN governance, the role monitors supplier delivery, contractual performance, service levels, lifecycle, risks, costs and improvement actions. The role prepares analysis, forecasts, recommendations and decision proposals for the Enterprise Network Service Owner. Budget accountability, cost-centre responsibility, contract ownership and final commercial decisions remain with the Enterprise Network Service Owner. Day-to-day operational coordination with the WAN managed service provider is performed by a designated WAN Operations Coordinator under the functional guidance of this role; overall WAN governance responsibility remains with this position.

For network service delivery, the role coordinates the shared operating model, queues, incidents, service requests, changes, problems, operational readiness and performance reporting. The role has no disciplinary or matrix people-management responsibility for network engineers. Engineering capacity and line management remain with the responsible managers, while this role provides process coordination, prioritisation transparency and cross-domain escalation.

The role works closely with the Enterprise Network Service Owner, Lead Network Architect, network engineers, IT Service Management, regional IT teams, Procurement, Finance and external network providers.

**Tasks and Qualifications:**
=============================

  

**1. WAN governance, roadmap and lifecycle - 15%**

* Prepare and maintain the proposed WAN service roadmap in alignment with the Enterprise Network Service Owner and Lead Network Architect.

* Identify lifecycle, resilience, capacity, sourcing and technical-debt risks and prepare recommendations for accountable decision makers.

* Track approved governance decisions and improvement actions to completion.

**2. WAN supplier and contractual-performance governance - 15%**

* Act as the primary operational governance interface for the WAN managed service provider, carriers and access providers.

* Monitor SLAs, KPIs, contractual obligations, potential service credits, risks and supplier commitments.

* Prepare evidence and recommendations for contract, renewal and commercial decisions owned by the Enterprise Network Service Owner.

* Lead supplier service reviews and escalate recurring underperformance, weak corrective actions and unresolved risks.

**3. WAN cost transparency, demand and transition assurance - 10%**

* Prepare cost, consumption and forecast transparency for review and approval by the Enterprise Network Service Owner; the role has no budget or cost-centre accountability.

* Assess the WAN service, supplier, commercial and operational implications of approved demands.

* Coordinate provider estimates, service acceptance and transition requirements with the demand owner, Lead Network Architect and Enterprise Network Service Owner.

* Ensure operational acceptance covers documentation, monitoring, testing, support routes, supplier acceptance and handover.

**4. WAN performance, data and continual improvement - 10%**

* Maintain WAN scorecards covering availability, incidents, capacity, resilience, change quality, supplier performance and cost transparency.

* Coordinate supplier follow-up after significant interruptions, including RCA quality and preventive actions.

* Maintain accurate governance artefacts and promote consistent data across ITSM, CMDB, monitoring, inventory and source-of-truth capabilities.

* Identify opportunities for automation, observability, data-quality improvement and reduced manual coordination.

**5. Enterprise Network operations coordination - 20%**

* Coordinate the BAU operating model across Campus LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN and DDI without assuming disciplinary or matrix people-management responsibility.

* Run queue reviews, service-health reviews and handover checkpoints; make ageing, blocked work and coverage gaps transparent.

* Coordinate operational priorities with line managers and engineering leads and escalate unresolved capacity conflicts to the Service Owner.

* Provide functional guidance to the designated WAN Operations Coordinator responsible for daily KION-provider coordination.

**6. Incident and service-request coordination - 15%**

* Coordinate triage, ownership, progression and documentation for incidents and service requests in the shared Enterprise Network queue.

* Coordinate cross-domain and high-priority incidents, bringing together network, security, application, infrastructure and supplier teams.

* Ensure clear ownership, timely escalation, stakeholder communication and disciplined technical handovers; specialist teams retain technical resolution responsibility.

* Monitor ticket ageing, reassignments and documentation quality and drive corrective action where required.

**7. Change, problem and operational-readiness governance - 10%**

* Coordinate operational risk reviews for significant or high-risk network changes, including production dependencies and rollback readiness.

* Drive follow-up of recurring problems, RCAs, known errors and preventive actions.

* Confirm that new or changed services enter BAU with monitoring, documentation, runbooks, support ownership, access and escalation routes in place.

**8. Operational performance and service improvement - 5%**

* Report queue health, response and restoration performance, recurring incidents, backlog, monitoring coverage and handover quality.

* Maintain and improve SOPs, runbooks, escalation contacts, service maps and operational knowledge.

Use operational trends to recommend improvements to resilience, automation, standards and training  

  

Interfaces

Internal:

* Secure Connectivity platform leadership, functional and team leads, and rotating operations engineers

* Enterprise and Network architecture; Cybersecurity and Information Security

* IT Service Management, e.g. Service Desk, (Major) Incident, Problem and Change

* Procurement, Legal, Finance/Controlling and Vendor Management

* Regional and onsite IT, business partners, programme and project managers

**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise-level customers.
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
