1ce0ae65.title: Technical Lead- Architecture and Engineering
1ce0ae65.company: Smartkheti Products, Opulent Infotech Pvt. Ltd.
1ce0ae65.description:
Build the technology that helps solve India’s water crisis

Chandigarh Tricity | Full-time | On-site

7–10 years preferred | 6+ years can be considered for an exceptional candidate

At **Wattr.ai**, we are building technology for one of India's most important and complex challenges — **water**.

We are creating the digital intelligence layer for real-world water infrastructure, connecting sensors, field systems, data, software and AI to help organisations monitor, understand and manage water infrastructure at scale.

And we are looking for a Technical Lead who wants to **own the technology behind it.**

This is not a role where you simply receive requirements and write tickets.

You will work across the entire product-engineering chain:

**Business Requirement → Product Requirement → System Architecture → Technical Design → Engineering Sprints → Task Allocation → Development → Testing → Deployment → Production → Scale**

**You will architect it.**

**You will build it.**

**You will lead the engineering team that executes it.**

**You will own technical delivery against product goals, KPIs and deadlines.**

What you will own

You will be the technical bridge between the **Product team and Engineering team**, translating what the business needs into systems that can actually be built, deployed and scaled.

You will:

→ Understand business and product requirements and convert them into technical solutions

→ Design the overall system architecture — application, APIs, databases, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure and integrations

→ Break architecture and product requirements into engineering modules, technical tasks and deliverables

→ Plan and drive engineering sprints based on product priorities, dependencies and deadlines

→ Assign work across developers based on technical complexity, priorities and individual strengths

→ Track sprint execution and ensure engineering commitments translate into actual product delivery

→ Identify technical risks, dependencies and bottlenecks early and drive them to resolution

→ Remain hands-on with development, particularly on critical or complex components

→ Review architecture, code and implementation decisions to maintain engineering quality

→ Work closely with Product to balance speed, scalability, reliability and business priorities

→ Own technical delivery from **0→1 and beyond**, taking products from an idea to a field-tested production system

Technology you will work across

This is a broad technical ownership role. You should be comfortable going deep across multiple layers of the stack:

**Frontend → Backend → APIs → Data → Real-time Systems → IoT → Cloud → Infrastructure → AI**

Full-stack Engineering

Strong hands-on experience with:

* **Node.js** and modern backend development
* **React** and frontend application development
* REST APIs and service integrations
* Databases and data modelling
* Authentication, authorization and application security
* Performance optimisation and production debugging

Cloud & Infrastructure

Strong experience with **AWS** and production cloud systems.

You should understand and ideally have hands-on experience with:

* EC2, S3, RDS / time-series databases and relevant AWS services
* AWS IoT Core or equivalent IoT cloud platforms
* Docker and containerised applications
* Kubernetes / EKS or equivalent
* CI/CD pipelines
* Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform
* Monitoring, logging and observability
* Cloud security, networking and reliability

The expectation is not simply to consume cloud infrastructure — you should understand how to **design, provision and evolve the infrastructure on which the product runs.**

IoT, Real-time & Data Systems

Wattr works with real-world infrastructure and continuously generated data.

Experience with any of the following is highly valuable:

* IoT platforms and connected devices
* MQTT / pub-sub architectures
* Sensor telemetry and real-time data ingestion
* Event-driven systems
* Kafka or similar streaming technologies
* Data ingestion / ETL pipelines
* Time-series data
* High-volume event processing
* Real-time alerts, monitoring and reporting
* Edge/cloud architectures

You should be comfortable thinking about:

**Device → Data → Backend → Processing → Intelligence → Dashboard → Action**

AI & AI-assisted Engineering

AI is becoming an important part of how we build intelligent infrastructure.

Experience with:

* LLMs / GenAI
* AI APIs and integrations
* RAG / agentic systems
* ML/AI pipelines
* AI-assisted development using tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude or equivalent is a strong advantage.

We are particularly interested in engineers who use AI tools **practically to increase engineering velocity and solve problems better**, rather than simply having theoretical exposure.

Architecture & System Design

Architecture ownership is **mandatory** for this role.

We are looking for someone with at least **2–3 years of genuine hands-on architecture / system-design experience**.

You should have experience with:

* Designing production systems from business requirements
* Defining system and service boundaries
* Making technology and architecture decisions
* Designing APIs and integrations
* Database and data architecture
* Distributed and event-driven systems
* Scalability and performance
* Reliability and fault tolerance
* Security and observability
* Cloud architecture and infrastructure
* Evolving architecture as products scale

Importantly, you should have **built the systems you architected**.

We are not looking for a pure enterprise architect or consulting architect who primarily produces diagrams and documents.

Technical Leadership

You will lead the engineering team technically and drive execution.

This includes:

Translating product requirements into technical plans

Breaking large requirements into manageable engineering tasks

Planning sprints and sequencing technical dependencies

Assigning work to engineers

Reviewing progress against sprint commitments

Unblocking developers when technical issues arise

Conducting code and architecture reviews

Mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards

Working with Product to manage technical trade-offs and delivery priorities

Ensuring engineering execution remains aligned with business KPIs and product deadlines

You may lead a small team of engineers, but **your primary identity should remain that of a strong hands-on engineer and technical leader.**

0→1 Ownership

We want someone who has experienced the journey:

**Idea → Architecture → First Build → MVP → Production → Scale**

You should have personally contributed to taking at least one product, platform or major system from **0→1** and subsequently helped scale or productionise it.

Startup experience is a strong advantage, particularly experience working in environments where engineers have to make decisions independently and move quickly.

What makes this role different

You won't be responsible for just one layer of the technology stack.

You will have visibility into the **entire product**.

You will understand why the product needs to exist → decide how it should be built → architect the system → break it into engineering work → lead the team through execution → write critical code yourself → deploy it → see it working in the real world.

And the real-world application is meaningful.

Water infrastructure

Connected devices

Live operational data

AI-driven intelligence

Large-scale infrastructure

Real impact across India

This is an opportunity to build technology where the systems you design don't just live inside a software product — **they interact with the physical world.**

What success looks like

In your first 6–12 months, you should be able to:

Take ownership of the technical architecture of key Wattr products

Translate product requirements into clear engineering plans

Establish an effective sprint and engineering execution rhythm

Build and ship a field-tested MVP rapidly

Bring live sensor/device data into reliable production systems

Build scalable backend and frontend systems

Establish robust APIs, data pipelines, alerts and reporting

Improve automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring and observability

Identify architectural bottlenecks before they become production problems

Help build an engineering culture focused on ownership, quality and delivery

Most importantly:

**The technology you build should become a competitive advantage for Wattr.ai.**

What we're looking for

7–10 years of software engineering experience preferred

6+ years can be considered for an exceptional candidate

**2–3+ years of hands-on architecture / system-design ownership is mandatory**

Strong hands-on full-stack engineering experience

Strong **Node.js + React** experience

Strong AWS / cloud experience

Experience setting up and evolving infrastructure

Strong understanding of APIs, databases and distributed systems

Experience with data pipelines / high-volume or real-time systems

0→1 product or platform development experience

Experience leading or mentoring engineers

Strong sprint planning, task breakdown and engineering execution skills

IoT / MQTT / telemetry / real-time systems experience is a strong advantage

AI / GenAI and AI-assisted development experience is a strong advantage

Excellent problem-solving and communication skills

Strong ownership mindset and ability to operate independently

This role is NOT

A pure people-management role

A pure enterprise architect role

A consulting / documentation-heavy architecture role

A backend-only or frontend-only role

A role where requirements are simply converted into tickets

We want someone who can:

**Understand → Architect → Break Down → Assign → Build → Review → Ship → Scale**

Why Wattr.ai?

Because this is an opportunity to build something that matters.

You will be working at the intersection of:

**Software × Cloud × IoT × Data × AI × Physical Infrastructure**

and applying those technologies to one of India's biggest real-world challenges.

If you are the kind of engineer who looks at a complex problem and thinks:

**“Let me understand the whole system — and then let me build it.”**

We would love to hear from you.

Pay: From ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Expected CTC
* Notice Period
* Current CTC
* Are you willing to relocate to Zirakpur

933fe054.title: Technical Architect – AWS AI Architect
933fe054.description:
Experience: 12+ Years

**Role Summary**

* Architect agentic solutions end to end: task decomposition, tool/function design, memory and state models, orchestration topology (supervisor, hierarchical, sequential, parallel), and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* + Design and tune production RAG pipelines — chunking, hybrid retrieval, reranking, query rewriting, metadata filtering, grounding and citation — and own the retrieval quality metrics, not just the pipeline diagram.
* + Build the evaluation layer alongside the system: golden datasets, trace-level assertions, LLM-as-judge rubrics, regression suites that gate deployment.
* + Select and justify the AWS service composition for each workload, with an explicit view on cost, latency, data residency, and failure modes.
* + Define guardrails and the security posture for agents that take real actions: least-privilege tool permissions, prompt injection defenses, PII handling, audit trails.
* + Set engineering standards for the practice — reference architectures, reusable agent and tool patterns, observability conventions — and mentor engineers into them.
* + Partner with client stakeholders on solution shaping, technical discovery, effort estimation, and proof-of-value scoping.

**Why This Role Matters**

Agentic AI systems fail in production for predictable reasons: unmanaged context windows, brittle orchestration, unscoped tool permissions, and no observability into why an agent did what it did. This role exists to prevent that — designing agent architectures on AWS (Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker) that are secure by default, cost-bounded, evaluable, and built to scale past the POC stage

**What You’ll Do**

We are seeking a strong AWS AI architect with hands-on expertise with At least two agentic or RAG systems taken to production on AWS, with evidence of ownership through the operate phase — not pilots that stopped at demo**.**

**Must-Have Skills**

2-3 year experience in Agentic system design Planning and execution loops, ReAct and plan-execute patterns, tool/function calling design, short- and long-term memory, state persistence and recovery, multi-agent orchestration and handoff design, MCP and A2A for tool and agent interoperability. Practical judgment on when an agent is the wrong answer and a deterministic workflow is the right one.

2-3 year experience in Agent frameworks Deep hands-on experience with at least two of: Strands Agents SDK, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex. Comfortable dropping to a custom orchestration loop where a framework gets in the way.

3 year experience in RAG engineering Production experience with document processing and chunking strategy, embedding model selection, vector and hybrid (BM25 + dense) retrieval, reranking, query decomposition, GraphRAG and agentic RAG patterns, context-window budgeting, and grounding/citation enforcement. Able to diagnose whether a bad answer came from retrieval, ranking, or generation.

AWS AI stack – 3 years of experience –

Amazon Bedrock — Converse API, model selection and routing, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Flows, prompt caching, batch vs. real-time inference and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore — Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity, Observability, Code Interpreter, Browser

Amazon SageMaker AI for custom model hosting, training, and endpoint operations and Vector and search: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, S3 Vectors, Aurora PostgreSQL with pgvector, Amazon Kendra.

5 years of experience in AWS core services Lambda, Step Functions, ECS/EKS/Fargate, API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, VPC and PrivateLink. Able to design a VPC-isolated, private-endpoint deployment for a regulated client without help.

7+ years of experience in Python engineering Production-grade Python — async, typing, Pydantic, FastAPI, structured testing. Clean, reviewable code; not notebook-only.

2+ years of experience Evaluation and LLMOps Offline and online evaluation design, RAGAS or equivalent retrieval metrics, trace-based observability (OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions, CloudWatch, Langfuse/LangSmith or similar), prompt and model versioning, token and cost governance, drift and regression detection.

2+ years of experience AI security and responsible AI Prompt injection and tool-abuse threat modeling, scoped tool permissions and action approval design, data classification and PII handling, content filtering, auditability. Working familiarity with an AI governance framework such as NIST AI RMF.

**Good to Have**

Model optimization — fine-tuning and LoRA/QLoRA, distillation into smaller or open-weight models, SLM deployment, structured decoding, latency/cost optimization under SLA.

Multimodal and voice — Amazon Nova models, Transcribe, Polly, real-time voice agent architectures and Infrastructure as code and CI/CD — AWS CDK or Terraform, GitHub Actions or CodePipeline, containerization, environment promotion strategy.

Data engineering foundations — AWS Glue, Kinesis, Kafka/Confluent, Lake Formation, Iceberg; designing the ingestion layer that feeds retrieval and Enterprise integration — SharePoint, ServiceNow, Salesforce, SAP, Confluence/Jira connectors and their authentication realities.

Regulated-industry delivery — HIPAA, GxP, SOC 2, or FedRAMP contexts; EU AI Act awareness and Frontend for AI — React or Streamlit for rapid proofs of value, streaming UX (SSE/WebSocket), interrupt and approval interfaces.

**What Success Looks Like (6–12 Months)**

Agentic AI systems move from prototype to production with defined SLAs, scoped permissions, and continuous evaluation — not fragile demos that break under real usage. Your architectural patterns become the org’s reusable default, cutting time-to-production for every team that builds after you.

**Why Join WinWire: Your Path to Professional Excellence in the Age of AI**

As an **Employer of Choice,** WinWire offers an exceptional workplace culture, industry recognition, and an unwavering commitment to employee growth. Here is why top talent chooses us:

* **AI-First. Globally Recognized**: Honored at the World Economic Forum in Davos for our pioneering "Agentic AI @ Scale" work, cementing our position as a forward-thinking, AI-first services firm shaping the future of enterprise technology.
* **Microsoft Gold Standard**: A **6x Microsoft** Global Partner of the Year Winner/Finalist — reflecting our consistent delivery of industry-leading solutions and our deep, trusted partnership with Microsoft.
* **Joining the NTT DATA Family**: WinWire (Part of NTT DATA), a $30 billion global leader in AI, digital business, and technology services. This means greater career stability, broader client exposure, and access to a vast landscape of opportunities across a truly global organization.
* **Award-Winning Culture**: Certified as a Best Place to Work® four times, our workplace culture is not just a talking point — it is a proven, recognized commitment to creating an environment where people genuinely thrive.
* **People-First Environment**: With a strong 4.0 Glassdoor rating, our employees speak for themselves. We prioritize wellbeing, inclusivity, and a culture of respect at every level of the organization.
* **Invest in Your Growth**: From continuous learning programs to structured career development pathways, we equip our team with the skills, tools, and opportunities needed to grow and lead in the age of AI.

aa743aac.title: Delivery Manager
aa743aac.description:
**Delivery Manager**

**A business-process outsourcing firm serving mid-market clients abroad, hiring for its delivery office**

**Location:**
Remote (India)

**The company**

A business-process outsourcing firm serving mid-market clients abroad, hiring for its delivery office. Client accounts run on agreed service levels, so accuracy and turnaround are watched closely. It has partnered with Flexiple to hire a delivery manager. Flexiple is a managed talent marketplace that places vetted professionals with companies in India and abroad.

**Why the role exists**

The manager owns delivery of client commitments, balancing scope, people and timelines across several active projects. Delivery here means client service levels, transition projects and steady-state accounts running in parallel.

**What you would run**

* Own delivery of multiple projects against scope, schedule and budget
* Plan resources across teams and resolve conflicts between projects
* Run status reviews and keep clients informed with honest updates
* Manage risks, dependencies and change requests
* Step in on escalations and agree recovery plans
* Coach project managers and team leads
* Track delivery metrics such as utilisation, slippage and client satisfaction

**Who we want**

* 7 to 12 years in delivery or programme management
* Graduate degree in engineering, management or a related subject
* Experience delivering client projects and leading project managers
* Strong planning, estimation and stakeholder skills
* Comfort with project tools and delivery reporting
* Calm handling of escalations

**Extras we value**

* PMP, PRINCE2 or Scrum credentials
* Experience with both agile and fixed-scope delivery
* Experience managing distributed teams

**What the seat offers**

* A Delivery Manager seat at a BPO firm, reporting to the head of delivery
* A hybrid arrangement based in Noida or Kolkata, with a long-term placement
* Leadership of a real delivery portfolio with visible client impact

**How we hire**

A screening call, an assignment, a round with the function head and another with senior leadership.

*There is no need to apply twice; a single application is checked against our other openings as well.*
